“I’m not interested in mating with an omega.”

Those were the words Phainon huffed out as he sat there lazily - eyes trailing after Aglaea as she walked back and forth. Pacing idly as they talked, as even though she was a royal advisor, sometimes it felt more like he was talking to a trusted friend.

.. Or like his mom, but he certainly wasn’t going to tell her that.

Aglaea sighed at those words however, pausing to turn in the garden and look at Phainon - eyes narrowed as she stood in the gardens of Okhema’s main castle with him, “I know.. After all, you continuously decline every invitation for an arranged marriage with them. Yet you must at least go through the offers.”

Time and time again they did this.

And time and time again he would refuse.

Always huffing out the same thing as the last time; “Just reject them, my heart belongs to an alpha.”

“And what alpha is that, Phainon?” Aglaea asked innocently, though she had already asked this many times before - trying her best to pry an answer for his sealed lips but he could never find it in himself to say.

As if it would shatter something inside of him to confess his love to someone else, before that man accepted him. Thus, he could only chuckle quietly. 

“I can’t tell you before I tell him! He deserves to know first and foremost.” Phainon told her from his chair, wagging his finger as if Aglaea was someone that needed to be scolded ever. 

.. Usually it was the opposite, and by ‘usually’ Phainon certainly meant ‘always’.

Aglaea only moved to cross her hands over her chest - sassily moving to lean on one foot as she paused her pacing. Seemingly giving up on going through the list of marriage offers in favor of chastising and reprimanding Phainon just a little, “And what if he has no interest in other alphas?”

Phainon’s eyes only moved to that now ignored stack of papers in her hands - he really should be honored that so many people desired him. But since they all were omegas and betas.. He couldn’t find it in himself.

Mainly because that meant one specific man wasn’t there, only making Phainon laugh a little as he shook his head, “Well! I will.. Figure it out!”

“Is that so?” Aglaea instantly asked, making Phainon wiggle a little in his chair over that sharpness in her voice - eyes moving to instead take in the greenery around them. Cyrene really had loved this garden and put the work into it, and Phainon..

.. Really had just been dragged out here by Aglaea to get scolded, it seemed. 

Phainon had to sigh over the bushes of flowers, all before looking back to Aglaea - eyes big  and wet, probably pouting and begging for mercy. At least, he hoped they were because that’s how he felt it in his heart and soul, “Listen.. I would wait all my life for that alpha, so I’m willing to decline everything again and again until I win his heart; okay?”

Aglaea stared over that. 

Not an overly harsh stare - but as an eyebrow slowly raised up her polished features, Phainon had to stop the urge to squirm in his chair and whine over that stare unblinking and focused on him. 

“Very well.” She gave in after a few moments, sighing,  “But you at least are attending this ball tonight, correct? Your sister would be rather disappointed if you did not.”

Phainon swayed a little over that in his chair, “Of course I am.. I just.. Am not interested in marriage outside of him, but I’ll mingle to the best of my abilities with the egotistical nobles and royalty.”

“Good to hear it.” Aglaea nodded, approving of that decision easily and not even commenting on the ‘egotistical’ part - probably due to the fact both of them knew it to be true, “I’ve already worked on your attire for the evening, do try to not let any eager omegas spill wine on your pants again.”

Phainon felt himself bite into his tongue to stop the full body shudder that had threatened to ransack through his body. Instead quietly letting out a small whine that was akin to a wet dog being left outside in the rain. 

“Trust me.. I don’t want that either.” Phainon borderline whimpered out over the memories of those omegas that had tried more than one tactic to seduce Phainon outside of just their scents.

“Of course you don’t, you seem to hate omegas.” Aglaea hummed out, shaking her head.

And that was silly! He didn’t hate them, he just.. Was not overly fond of them, he could admit it. But maybe that was also just due to the fact the man who had stolen his heart was an alpha, he had no time for omegas and betas trying to win his heart over.

“I don’t hate them. I just don’t want one as my mate.” Phainon huffed out, eyes only able to think of that blonde haired man that haunted him in his dreams and his waking moments. Only longing for days when he would be right at Phainon’s side yet again.. 

Aglaea huffed over that, already moving away idly as she seemed more focused on something else now. “Right, whatever it may be - Sit still so I may dress you decently, won’t you?”

“.. Yes ma’am.”

──────────────

Phainon didn’t have many plans for this party - it was his sister’s birthday and that meant schmoozing with guests and vapid nobles. But there had been one specific guest that had his eye all night, one that made his head turn to steal a glance at him. Eyes unable to look away when the golden haired man was near - trained on him and taking in the sight of him.

The yearning was almost unbearable.

Being in the same room but unable to talk, unable to hold that man and kiss his worries away. Instead having to meet with the nobles and beam his usual charming smiles at them, trying to satiate whatever they desired all while his eyes kept finding that man.

The Crown Prince of Castrum Kremnos: Mydeimos. 

“Hello there!” Phainon greeted happily as he found that man finally alone, back turned as he seemed to be busying himself with refreshments. But that didn’t matter - Phainon knew Mydei when he saw him, besides..

No one else had flaming hair quite like that prince. 

Mydei turned leisurely, blinking as their eyes met, “.. Prince Phainon, it’s nice to see you again.”

Phainon hated that tone.

Mydei’s business one, stoic and standoffish, the one he used when he was purposefully keeping someone at a distance. The one he had probably been using all night and refused to fall into a more comfortable tone.

.. Or Phainon was just someone he now saw as someone he wanted to keep away from himself - but Phainon didn’t dare think about that possibility for too long, lest his sanity slip from him. 

“You as well, Prince Mydeimos! You look as stunning as ever!” Phainon chose to chirp out instead, basking in how regal that man looked in his formal suit attire, mantle dramatically over one shoulder and fully looking like a lion due to the fur around his neck.

Sleek in black and red - and Phainon had always thought Mydei looked best in red, especially with his tattoos that only seemed to pop more against the black of his outfit. 

“Do I?” Mydei asked a bit quietly, as if he hadn’t been expecting the compliment - and that only made Phainon take a step closer, trying his best to get as close as possible to the alpha without making him feel a bit defensive.

Not yet, at least..

Phainon nodded a bit eagerly, all before moving to join Mydei at the table - hoping that would be a fine excuse to brush their shoulders together as he innocently scanned the refreshments, “Mhm.. How goes things in Castrum Kremnos?”

Only, it didn’t work.

Mydei took a simple step away as soon as they touched, just to begin speaking in that same calculated and cold tone, “The same as always, I prefer not to dwell on those matters while at a ball. Tell Princess Cyrene I wish her a very happy birthday.”

Phainon nodded, eyes moving to look at that alpha instead of the food and drinks - after all, Mydei was much more interesting to him, “Mhm, I will.. You should visit Okhema more like you did when you were younger, we all miss you, you know?”

“I’m older now.” Mydei pointed out, as if Phainon needed a reminder of that. He was two years older than Mydei, but that didn’t make his mind change much on any topic involving the man, “My place is not there.”

“I’d argue it certainly is!” Phainon hummed out effortlessly, moving his eyes to watch people dance around instead of staring down the man of all his affections.

‘My place is not there’. Foolish words, considering Phainon felt like Mydei’s place absolutely was at his side.. Though, Phainon was willing to move to Kremnos, if that was what the alpha was saying to him. 

Anything, for just one chance at happiness at Mydei’s side.. That’s all he was asking for in this lifetime - was he really being too greedy?

“Mm.”

Small talk had never been Mydei’s favorite thing, always seeming to skip it when they were at events - trying his best to leave the conversations. And that made Phainon’s mind prick with unrest as he considered that man trying to escape him.

Getting bored of his talk and walking away from Phainon.

Phainon had to suck in a deep breath over that, trying not to dwell on it too much as he gave a stern look to Mydei instead, “Mydei.”

“Hmm?” Was all Mydei offered up, and Phainon had to resist the urge to sniff at him, to nose against the slightly shower man’s nape and sniff at his scent glands to take them in. Even now as they seemed muted, kept under wraps politely at a party - Phainon could smell it.

The lavender in his scent mixed with something floral that went hand in hand with the scent of wood - such a deep alpha scent that had always perplexed Phainon when he smelled it. There was always something so vibrant and sweet beneath it all, a scent that Phainon desperately wanted to riddle out but couldn’t due to the fact he couldn’t sniff at his neck.

Instead, he had to wistfully sigh and give that crown prince a small smile, “Would.. You ever accept an arranged marriage from another alpha?”

Mydei seemed to tense up over that - all before looking a little confused, tilting his head to the side and causing golden locks of hair the feather around his face gently, “Another alpha?”

“Yes.” Phainon nodded, trying his best not to seem too eager over the way he was practically begging to be given a chance.

He was another alpha, he could easily be someone Mydei was interested in!

Mydei sighed however, moving a hand to pinch at the bridge of his nose as if this topic was bothering him, “.. I believe so, I’ve already been declined by many before.”

Declined..?

Mydei had tried to find someone that wasn’t Phainon, then? He needed to work quickly and restlessly.. He certainly didn’t enjoy the heavy weight that had settled into his stomach over the fact that Mydei was looking for a mate already.

.. And he hadn’t asked Phainon first of all.

“Really?! You prefer alphas?” Phainon asked, unable to stop the way he could feel his nonexistent tail wagging as he asked the question, doing his best to ignore the foreboding emotion building in his chest over Mydei not even considering him as a first choice.

Mydei barely looked at him over that - but Phainon didn’t need those eyes on him to be able to see the twitch in Mydei’s jaw. The rigidness in his bones. As if he were stressed over this topic, and Phainon was rather sure he could smell his scent souring.

.. Was Phainon really such a bad option that even asking about Mydei’s lovelife was angering the alpha?

“Why would I not? They’re strong people with sturdy bodies.. They’re a good match for someone like me.” Mydei mindlessly muttered, seeming less than a little amused over this conversation.

He was assuredly an angry alpha over being asked this.. Had their bond become so distant that Mydei didn’t even consider him, even though he liked alphas?

Phainon really didn’t understand, especially not with that wording as he swallowed harshly, “Someone like you.. Right! Well, may I have a dance, my lovely Mydeimos?”

Mydei was silent for a few heartbeats, much too long that Phainon could feel his skin burning with anxiety as he waited for an answer. Those golden eyes didn’t even look at Phainon, not once as he seemed wholly focused on the people actually dancing, all before finally picking what he wanted to say.

“Don’t feel required to dance with me, we’re not children anymore, Phainon.”

A dry and still rather annoyed sounding response to where Phainon couldn’t help but shift his weight between his feet. 

Phainon couldn’t help but chuckle out a nervous set of laughter, trying his best to sound soothing as he ignored those sour upset scents from Mydei so painfully distant, “Nonsense, who else would I dance with if not you?”

Mydei’s eyes flicked to him over that - a brow raising inquisitively, “.. Your other suitors who interest you instead of your childhood friend.”

Other suitors.

Right.

Phainon found himself laughing over that as well, less nervous and more distraught over the idea of Mydei thinking someone could ever replace him. Even if Mydei felt he could replace Phainon, it.. It was not mutual vice versa, there was only Mydei for him. 

“Heh.. What if catching up with my childhood friend interests me more than they do?” Phainon put a hand on his hip, giving a small tilt of his head as he asked the question as well.

“You already know enough about me.” Mydei grumbled out, and Phainon had a few thoughts on that, about how he didn’t know enough at all in their adult years.

But it didn’t matter. 

“Crown Prince Mydeimos!” 

Phainon’s blood ran cold with those chirped out words, so eager and happy that Phainon found his own scent souring - turning to a territorial one against his own desires as the speaker walked up beside him. Beaming. 

Blue eyes wide and doting as she ignored Phainon, focusing wholly on Mydei as her lightened salt and pepper colored hair bounced with every movement - so happy as she extended a hand to Mydei.

“Ah.. You are..” Phainon started, because he did know this alpha that was swooping in to speak to Mydei. He had met her a few times, but he never had quite bonded with her - especially because she seemed close to Mydei of all people.

Strange.

He had such a strange burning feeling replacing the heavy weight in the depths of his stomach as he blankly stared at her. 

“Cifera..” Mydei finished his sentence however, sounding a bit confused - or maybe relieved over her being there.

But the horrors seemed endless for Phainon as that alpha immediately spoke, “Mydeimos, may I have a dance?”

Phainon couldn’t even stop his mouth from opening - feeling like he was going a little insane over how it felt like Mydei was being stolen away from him so easily, “But I-”

“Of course, Cifera..” Mydei himself interrupted, making Phainon’s mind reel in its tracks - staring at that beautiful alpha who was now taking ahold of Cifera’s own hand. Gently letting himself be led away from Phainon..

“Mydei.. Wait I..” Phainon trailed off, feeling the way his body was tensing up - desiring so badly to reach that man and grab him back. To lead him away and have his own dance with him hand in hand, putting Mydei’s head on his shoulder as he led their feet into a smooth circle.

Mydei did pause however, not looking back for a few moments, only to look at Phainon leisurely - golden eyes meeting blue as he blinked at Phainon expectantly, “What is it?”

“.. Nothing. I hope your dance is lovely.” Phainon murmured after a few moments of silence with the sound of music in the distance, all to stare at Mydei and take a step back.

What was he supposed to do?

Proclaim his love and beg for that alpha not to leave, all while Cifera already had his hand in her own - already making the distance between Mydei and Phainon into a rift that Phainon felt.. Unwell to think about.

“Try to chin up, Prince Phainon! Your scent is extremely heavy and sour right now, you know? Way too suffocating to dance with you in that condition!” Cifera told him as Mydei joined her at her side, and Phainon found that.. Ceaselessly annoying and ironic that she of all people was saying that to him.

Arguably, the reason behind his mood souring so instantly as he blinked at her. 

“Okay.” Phainon replied flatly, staring after the duo as Cifera had effortlessly taken Mydei away from him - leaving him standing there dumbly and almost a bit numb.

Phainon could do nothing but stare after them, blinking over that alpha woman who had so effortlessly stolen him. He found his feet moving on their own as he moved up stairs, walking each step so painfully leisurely to join his sister up there. 

All while his fingers trailed on the railing -  coldly dragging their way upwards as his mind felt as numb and empty as his heart currently did. 

“I’m surprised it’s not you dancing with Mydei..” Cyrene mumbled as he climbed up those stairs to the second story to join her - his eyes still focused on Mydei wholly.

Unable to look away from his fluid motions of dancing with Cifera, easily moving in rhythm with each other without a care in the world. A smile so fond on Mydei’s face, all before they spun and his face was looking away from Phainon’s. Hidden from him yet again, making Phainon heave out a sigh.

“.. Maybe I took too long and his heart is already someone else’s.” Phainon murmured out, staring at the way Mydei’s soft hair bounced with every gentle step that they had learned together in their childhood.

Now being put to work with someone that wasn’t Phainon, even though he.. Felt like it should be him there in Mydei’s arms. Moving and swaying together, now and forevermore.. 

Cyrene made a sweet humming noise - clearly amused just a tiny bit over Phainon’s frustrations as she inched closer to where he had stopped, “Surely you don’t think that’s Cifera, right? They’re basically siblings with how close they are.”

Phainon had to grit his teeth over that - eyes unable to look away from how gentle and elegant Mydei looked while dancing. Even if that dance simply meant he was growing more and more away from Phainon.

“What if he’s just not interested in me and this is his nice way of telling me?” Phainon inquired, the words leaving a bitter taste on his tongue as he spat the words out - eyes narrowing to look at that alpha who had whisked him away so swiftly.

The fond and happy smile on her face all while talking to Mydei, too quiet for others to hear, assuredly.. 

“C’mon.. You guys were best friends for so long, don’t give up so quickly on him.” Cyrene pointed out, but those words only worked to make Phainon more uncomfortable. More unhappy. 

“Were.” Phainon pointed out, unable to stop the venom that was dripping from that singular word as he felt himself deflate more and more every time those two seemed to laugh and have a good time together dancing.

It almost felt like they were trying to spite him in a way, but he also knew Mydei wasn’t that type of shallow person, either. 

“Huh?” Cyrene asked at his side, sounding baffled as his blow eyes moved to look at her - staring her in the eyes before he sighed deeply over it. 

“You used were in that sentence. We were best friends.. She’s evidently replaced me, and everyone can see it.” Phainon explained to her, feeling the way those words sunk heavy into his own soul as he said them. Eyes jerking back to Cifera, focusing on the alpha that had stolen Mydei away and that..

Made Phainon only wonder what she had that he didn’t have..?

They had such a good bond as children, and Mydei had always seemed almost eager when he promised to marry him every now and then, but.. Now he was moving on to that alpha.

Why?

What was Phainon missing? What did Cifera have that made Mydei more happy with her, in her arms, than with Phainon..?

“Oh, you’re being nitpicky now..” Cyrene huffed out, sounding so painfully exasperated over her brother’s antics but he didn’t understand why as he watched Mydei like a hawk. Unable to look away from him. 

“It’s just the truth, isn’t it? He’s not interested in me in the slightest.” Phainon asked, fighting the urge to ask why the birthday princess was even hiding up here anyway - instead just watching Mydei mindlessly. 

Cyrene instead waved a hand at him, fanning him for emphasis, “Your scent is really awful right now, you know that, right?”

Phainon tutted over that, clicking his tongue loudly over it as he leaned more onto the railing - staring at the ballroom beneath them more blankly. 

“.. I don’t care. He’s not close enough to smell me anyway.” Phainon muttered out, “I want to scent him so badly.. She’s so close to him and rubbing her smell on him..”

Cyrene sighed so dreadfully dramatically over that, clearly at the end of her ropes in regards to trying to keep her brother sane in his time of need, “Okay.. Jealous, much? Why didn’t you ask him to dance before her then?”

“He hates dancing.” Phainon hissed at her, all before feeling even stupid as he thought about it again, “He always used to be upset when they made us practice dancing together as kids, and I did ask.. He refused.”

“Oh. Well.. He looks to be enjoying himself now with her, doesn’t he?” Cyrene asked, and Phainon.. Didn’t understand she was pointing this out to him - wasn’t it like rubbing salt into a fresh wound in this scenario..?

“.. He does.” Phainon conceded, even if he didn’t want to agree to it - he couldn’t deny the happiness he saw lingering in Mydei’s features softly. The way he looked as comfortable with her as he did in Phainon’s own memories of them laughing together and spending their days together. 

.. Was Phainon really such a fool that he had waited so long and let someone else take Mydei from him? Steal away his happiness that he thought would never leave him..?

“Try to chin up, I think they’re just friends.” Cyrene told him with a small and rather bubbly laugh considering Phainon’s current dreadful mood, “You’re just being jealous and moody for no reason. Don’t scare him with your scent.”

But Phainon couldn’t find it in him to care about that - only pouting a bit more, “.. The dance is ending.”

“Fix your sour scent before you go chasing after him, okay?” Cyrene chastised lightly, only adding to make Phainon press out a heavy and deep sigh over the fact she was so horribly correct, “You’ll scare the poor alpha.”

Even as she walked away now to go back to her own party - Phainon couldn’t help but watch that alpha finish his dance with Cifera and move away from her. Seemingly moving to get a drink of something, all before downing it and refilling it, making Phainon blink over how thirsty he was, but he supposed that was none of his business.. 

.. Even if he felt a little worried as Mydei downed another drink of the liquid immediately.

“Mn.. He said happy birthday, by the way..”

──────────────

“Mr. Crown Prince.”

Mydei swirled his glass over that - he had never been big on drinking alcohol, especially due to how drunk he got immediately off of it. But he couldn’t help himself tonight.

He had been running from his own feelings for so very long, that the sight of Phainon smiling at people and shaking hands - so eager and happy made it all come crashing down on him. That wasn’t his, and never would be. 

In the memories of them as children laughing and playing together before they both presented, that smiling beaming face of Phainon’s had been a ray of sunshine in his life. Not to mention the times Phainon would weave flowers tenderly into the form of a ring for Mydei, always putting it on Mydei’s hand and saying they would marry one day.

.. What a bitter joke that memory was now for Mydei to be trapped with. Now he had already been rejected in marriage by that very same man, no longer caring or doting on Mydei, completely moving on. Meanwhile Mydei was foolish enough to have hope and dream of that day becoming real, being Phainon’s mate and staying by his side happily.

He should have moved on years ago like Phainon did, maybe that would have stopped him from having his third glass of wine this evening as he stared out of that fancy marble balcony and into the Okhema city below them numbly.

“Cifera.” Mydei replied, but he didn’t take his eyes away from the night life of the city - instead using it to ignore the ongoing party behind him.

He didn’t particularly feel like partying, not anymore. He had come to terms that this was probably his last chance with Phainon and to win his heart, and now.. He had to accept it was over, all while bringing that cup to his lips again to taste the bitter fruit that would numb his mind further. 

“How long do you intend on running from that man?” Cifera asked as she walked up beside him - putting her elbows on the railing to lean against it. And as he caught a breath of his scent flooding his nose - he felt jealous.

Just this once that he didn’t have a scent like hers, not one that was likeable to Phainon. His own scent was akin to an alpha’s, sure, but it apparently had some undertone of sweetness that most people disliked. And Phainon was probably included in ‘most people’ nowadays..

“Forever.” Mydei grumbled out, hanging his head a little as the burn of his emotions threatened his eyes again - unable to control his emotions tonight it seemed as he tried to calm his scent down by standing out here. Praying his scent blockers did enough, since he had been told time and time again he didn’t smell as sweet as a normal omega did.

He wasn’t petite, he wasn’t cute and tiny for an alpha to love on, he was big and bulky - smelling musky and woody like an alpha. There was no big secret why he wasn’t anyone’s first choice in a sweet omega if they wanted one.

He was probably back of the line, if anything, considering the fact Phainon who had always talked about marrying him changed his tone so quickly after they both presented their secondary genders.

.. What a joke his life was. 

“Seriously?” Cifera asked, making Mydei bubble out  a small laugh over her confusion, a strained noise as he tilted his head up again. Once more swirling his drink lazily as he stared at nothing in particular. 

“He already declined my attempt at an arranged marriage, it would have strengthened both our kingdoms, and I trust him the most with my life.” Mydei explained dully, eyes staring at that maroon liquid in his cup as he tried to force himself not to stay fixed on that fact, “But I’m not the type of omega he would desire, I know that much.”

Cifera gave a heavy exhale over that, as if she were debating something all before eventually speaking her mind on the matter; “I don’t know.. I’ve heard rumors of something awful as well..”

Rumors.

There were a lot of those going around about Phainon, he knew that better than most people considering how nosey he had been towards the alpha. Desperately clawing and trying to find a way back into that man’s life - but it had been utterly fruitless. 

He didn’t like omegas, that much was obvious. 

“Hmm?” Mydei pressed out, moving his eyes to focus on Cifera all before she sighed.

“He’s been declining every omega..” Cifera started, trailing off as she shook her head - waving a hand lazily, “Because he’s in love with some alpha already.”

Mydei blinked, all before returning to looking out at the city, “Oh.”

“Sorry, probably a bad time to bring it up, huh?” Cifera asked, making his eyes jerk to her again before looking away. Giving a quiet chuckle over the way she seemed to feel guilty.

But there was nothing for her to feel guilty over as his eyes moved to his glass again.

“No, it’s fine.. I’ve heard that rumor as well, anyway.” Mydei confessed, “Hard not to hear it when he’s the most desirable alpha for royalty mating right now..”

Cifera moved a little over that, crossing her arms over her chest as she tilted her head - giving Mydei such a simper smile, “And you’ve been in love with him since childhood.. Fate is so cruel.”

“I’m happy for him.”

Liar.

Mydei had always been such a horrible liar, and yet here he was - trying to lie yet again. 

“The omega that still curls up in one of Phainon’s spare shirts from years past is happy for Phainon finding someone else? I doubt that.” Cifera hissed at him, and in hindsight.

He really didn’t know why he tried to lie to her of all people about being happy for Phainon moving on and no longer caring about Mydei. 

“It’s no matter.” Mydei admitted, giving a quiet scoff as well, “I will marry whoever my mother sets me up with instead for the sake of our kingdom. It just simply will not be Phainon, and I need to accept that.”

“You’re going to accept any other random alpha, when you’ve only wanted and loved one guy in specific?” Cifera asked, seeming wholly unconvinced as she laughed over her own words - or the foolishness of Mydei’s actions as he blinked a glare at her leisurely. 

“What other choice do I have?” Mydei asked, genuinely curious as he looked for her for an answer.

An answer not even she had as she shook her head slowly, “This is really so sad..”

“What is?”

Mydei tensed up over that - eyes jerking to look at that prince that was so painfully familiar, yet now woefully foreign to him as Phainon gave him a smile. A forced and hollow thing as his eyes moved between Mydei and Cifera - annoyed no doubt over their dance when Phainon had been speaking to him first and asked.

But..

Mydei genuinely believed that man should spend his time seeking out people who actually interested him, not wasting it on the omega he already rejected.

“Prince Phainon! How nice to see you again! Here! Now!” Cifera chirped out awkwardly and much too stiffly, clearly unaware that the prince had been walking up on them just as Mydei was. And Mydei didn’t know what her excuse was, but his was definitely the alcohol.. 

Phainon’s eyes moved to focus on her - almost looking passively aggressive as they narrowed slightly, “.. Well, the party isn’t over yet, I thought I would continue checking in on my old friend, if that’s alright.”

Cold.

Everything he was saying was so cold and distant, like he was forcing himself to even want to speak to Mydei right now. And that only made Mydei’s mind burn more with the shame that he had held on to such stupid emotions for so long. 

“Of course! I’m just.. Uh..” Cifera waved her hands in that, clearly in mock surrender as her eyes danced between the two men, “Gotta go, see you two in a bit! Mydei, if you need me, you know how to find me easily..”

“Mhm..” Mydei hummed out, barely able to reply as he looked at that alpha who only watched her go - all before immediately turning his head to focus on Mydei instead. Changing his forced smile into something softer - something that made Mydei’s stomach churn over the way it was not meant for him.

Not really. 

“Haha.. She seemed to be in a hurry, what’s so sad? It’s my job as a host to make sure you’re fine, you know..” Phainon told him, practically purring out his words as he took a few more steps forward to Mydei oddly. Almost like he was testing the waters.

But that was just humorous to Mydei as he looked at the glass still in his hand that he hadn’t finished off yet. 

“She’s upset I’ll be getting into an arranged marriage soon.” Mydei told him, huffing out a small laugh as he spoke those words. 

“.. What?”

Mydei shrugged, unable to understand why that alpha of all people seemed to be so horrified and shocked over that statement, “My first choice in marriage rejected me, so I’m doing my best to move on. That’s all.”

“Your first choice rejected you..?” Phainon’s voice was oozing his confusion in every word - upsetment settled into them coldly and Mydei had to bite back a small whine that was bubbling into his throat. Doing his best to ignore the blatant and immediate souring of Phainon’s scent, clearly distressed over something.

And Mydei wanted to comfort him, to move and nuzzle on him, sweetening his scent to make that alpha keen and purr instead..

Yet all he could do was freeze and stand there - body numb and tense as he considered the fact it was Phainon.

Phainon himself had rejected him, he didn't want Mydei as his omega, and he certainly wouldn’t want Mydei scenting him and trying to soothe his distress. All Mydei could do was stand there uselessly, just like he always had done when it came to comforting his closest friend.

“Listen.. I don’t know why you think you need to be married so quickly and have a mate, but Okhema has been one of Kremnos’s longest comrades, right? Just..” Phainon muttered out those words, seeming almost fidgety as he spoke - nervous beyond words bizarrely over the situation, “Remember that, okay? I’m your.. Best friend, okay? No matter how far away we are..”

Best friend.

That was ironic considering how much Phainon had seemed to struggle to say that, evidently not even able to tell himself that and believe it.

Mydei had to look away from him due to that, instead biting into his gums slowly; “.. Thank you.”

“Any.. Anytime. What uh.. Haha, what are your options so far?” Phainon’s words were just as useless and hollow as before - sounding like he was disgusted or hurt over this topic. 

Mydei couldn’t wrap his mind around it, just because Phainon had rejected him already, did he consider Mydei completely unable to be loved by someone else..?

Mydei clicked his tongue over his own thoughts - doing his best to try to imagine it wasn’t that. Phainon had always been a kind friend to him, he probably didn’t want to see Mydei suffer alone, right?

“I don’t know. Mother wishes me to meet a doting alpha who would adore me, but I think that’s a hard ask in an arranged marriage.” Mydei huffed out, biting back a bitter laugh over the way he knew he was doomed.

Love in an arranged marriage? Being used as anything more than just a way for an alpha to pump out some pups?

As if. 

“It’s not that hard, you’re a wonderful man and anyone would be.. More than just a little lucky to have you, Mydeimos..” Phainon murmured, his voice soft and sweet.

But Mydei could only find himself scoffing over those words, over how ironic it was for this man of all people to be saying someone would be lucky to have him. The very same man that had made a hundred promises in their childhood to marry him, only to reject him in adulthood when Phainon realized Mydei wasn’t someone he wanted at all.

Phainon couldn’t possibly think that, not when he had moved along and fallen in love with an alpha and rejected Mydei.

.. Would fate have been different if he had presented as an alpha, instead of an omega?

“.. Right.” Mydei eventually found himself saying, biting into his gums a little as he spoke those words - moving his eyes back to that glass again. 

Phainon remained quiet for a few moments, all before making an odd little humming noise - one that would normally read as innocent, but Mydei knew him too well for that. This alpha was planning or snooping, and it was probably the latter.

“So you’re.. Marrying for political reasons?” 

It was in fact the latter.

Mydei had to bring that drink back to his lips - taking another drink of it before even bothering to reply to that question; “I believe so.” 

Phainon was silent for a few moments, and Mydei found that to be fine as he focused on the city below them - swirling his cup against mindlessly as Phainon took his sweet time conjuring a reply. Not that Mydei blamed him, it was probably awkward as all hell to try to comfort someone in regards to love, when you yourself had already rejected them.

“.. But you never wanted to do that?” Phainon eventually stated as he joined at Mydei’s side - also leaning on that balcony railing. Stealing the place of Cifera, and making Mydei cut a side eye to that alpha who seemed a bit too keen on watching Mydei as well.

“Times change, and so do people.” Mydei muttered a bit flatly as his eyes flickered away from Phainon and back towards a city that he once called his second home. One that felt much too cold to him now.

 “I understand my role now, that’s all, and I apologize for ever doubting it.” Mydei added before taking another heavy drink of his wine, very aware of the way Phainon was watching him. Studying him almost, but it’s not like Mydei cared.

He wasn’t Phainon’s worries or burden to dread about, he knew that much.

“I’m not the someone you need to apologize to, Mydei..” Phainon told him, voice smooth as silk as he uttered that - all before pausing for a beat of a second, “By the way, I didn’t think you drank much?”

Mydei lowered his drink again over that, “.. I don’t.”

“Mydeim-”

“Phainon,” That voice was a new one, one that made Mydei turn around to match the way Phainon had spun around at a lightning quick speed. Obviously respecting the speaker; “Oh, you must be Crown Prince Mydeimos, it’s a pleasure to meet you. I am merely Lady Aglaea.”

Mydei moved a few feet at that, all to accept that extended hand with his own free one - vaguely aware of the way Phainon had followed behind him to her silently. 

Watching him still.

“Hello, nice to meet you as well, Lady Aglaea.” Mydei nodded, shaking her hand politely - but there was something else that was itching at his mind. His eyes could only wander back to that alpha who had stiffened, seeming so on edge and deeply affected instantly. 

Blue eyes only fixed on the golden woman’s own, and that’s when Mydei finally understood and it had clicked in his mind so easily.

This was the alpha Phainon was so deeply in love with, huh?

“Pardon me for ruining your conversation, Phainon, there’s something that requires your attention direly.” Aglaea spoke sternly, demanding respect so swiftly that Mydei could understand it all so easily.

She was strong, beautiful, and an alpha. Everything about her screamed elegant and proper, gentle and refined. 

So much that Mydei found himself taking a step away - blinking to look at his own hands and thinking about how small her hands had felt in his own. 

He wasn’t what Phainon wanted at all, was he?

All those words and cherished memories were just that, haunting memories for Mydei now - and most likely nothing that Phainon even thought of anymore. Why would he when an alpha who smelled faintly of Phainon already was right there in Okhema with him?

“Yes. Good bye, Mydei.” Phainon rigidly spoke, making Mydei blink his eyes a little over that - all to drag his glass up to his lips and take another swig. Praying that he would be able to drink enough to forget that woman’s scent.

Deep, rich and heavy, reminiscent of pine trees and rain - not unpleasant, but it was nothing compared to Phainon’s scent of clove and tea, just the slightest dash of citrus buried sweetly beneath it all.

.. But Mydei would need to drink even more to try to forget that as well, moving his eyes to focus on his cup as he moved it away from his mouth - licking his lips idly to try to swipe the taste off himself and doing his best not to read into the way Phainon was watching his every move. Doing his best to ignore the way Phainon’s scent was changing so quickly into something more bitter.

Territorial.

Phainon was warning Mydei about being too close to Aglaea.

A scent that had always been so soft and comforting to Mydei, now was warning him to go away - to leave Phainon’s desired mate alone.

A desired mate that wasn’t Mydei, not anymore. 

Mydei scoffed over it, taking a step to the side away from them both - not desiring getting maimed as he blinked at that confused expression on Phainon’s face. A flickering thing before it left so quickly, clearly not going to bother asking in front of his lover or draw attention to it. 

Mydei shook his head, instead moving to down the rest of his drink in a swift chugging competition with no one but himself invited, just to toast his glass to them both, “.. Good bye, Phainon.”

Only, Phainon didn’t move - his eyes flicking from that empty glass to Mydei’s face, obviously worried as he instead took a small step closer towards Mydei. 

“Mydei.. You never drink, I should.. You should let me accompany you home. I..” Phainon trailed off, and Mydei had to tilt his head over that. He was perfectly capable of getting home alone even if he was drunk, furthermore..

His eyes drifted to Aglaea again, not even shocked as she seemed so disproving of that - a frown gracing her features now, “Phainon, we do not have time for that.”

“.. Yes, Aglaea.” Phainon barely mumbled out, taking a step back as if he was a wet dog as his eyes looked to Aglaea expectantly. Obediently.

And something about that made Mydei’s jaw clench just the tiniest bit. 

Mydei shrugged over it, eyes moving back to the city life as he gave a laugh over his feeble attempt before his mate had scolded him, “It’s alright. I’ve got Cifera to take care of me if she wants to.”

That seemed to make Phainon freeze up even more - and his scent was already a swirl of mixed emotions to where Mydei couldn’t even tell what this man was feeling anymore with them. Instead just wrinkling his nose over how upset and distraught Phainon seemed to be, Mydei could only look at Phainon’s desired mate for a silent plea of help.

He had no idea what to do about this man, nor how to make him feel better over this.

.. Did Phainon really just hate the idea of someone caring for Mydei that much? They used to be friends, and after Phainon’s big sweet talk, he thought they still had a little bit of a bond..

Maybe he had been overselling it, though. Just being nice to a distressed omega as a good alpha should be in public.

Mydei really was pathetic and almost mourned the fact he was out of wine, he desperately needed another cupfull if he was going to survive the trip home. 

“T.. Take care of you.. I want t-”

“Phainon, we must go now.” Aglaea cut in, making Mydei snort a bit quietly, eyes darting away. Not particularly caring to watch as Phainon left his life yet again, this time more permanently.

“.. Yes.” Phainon mumbled, already walking away, and Mydei didn’t bother saying goodbye again - but neither did Phainon. Instead merely moving to return to that balcony - slouching as he resumed leaning on it lazily.

Terrible.

Terrible, awful, and absolutely no good. That’s what this night was, and he was out of wine.

“Yeesh, I thought he would never leave. Who was that pretty lady?” A familiar voice asked, replacing the merry distant music of the ballroom music drilling into Mydei’s head with her quiet chuckles.

A welcomed sound to help hold off his own insanity as he looked over his shoulder to Cifera, shaking his head slowly, “His desired mate, I think.”

“She smelled heavily of him..” Cifera murmured, “Sounds likely..”

Mydei was appreciative that she didn’t hold too much back unless it would truly crush Mydei, but at this point he didn’t think he could go any lower as he focused into the night air again. 

“Is my scent really so unappealing?”  Mydei mindlessly asked, feeling as if he was growing more and more hopeless in regards to this situation.

It didn’t matter anyway, not anymore. This was his last chance, and if anything.. He had merely come to terms that Phainon wasn’t his, and that he might actually enjoy drinking a little with how fuzzy his mind felt. Even if he did feel the desire to cry creeping in on him constantly. 

Cifera took her rightful spot at his side, all before looking at him confusedly, “Hmm?”

“I’m wearing scent blockers tonight, but..” Mydei breathed in the now growing chilly air - nose lingering on Phainon’s scent that had soured so horribly as soon as he got near Aglaea, “I can’t compete with an alpha when all he likes are alphas, can I?”

Cifera was silent for a moment, “I don’t know how to comfort you on this topic.. I miss Hyacine..”

“I fear I’m hopeless when it comes to love, regardless. But at least I don’t have to think about that soon.” Mydei grumbled out, moving a hand to comb through his own bangs - pushing them back uselessly as they flopped back onto his face instantly.

All to just fiddle with the braid at the side of his head instead, knitting his brows as he twirled that golden cuff between his fingers languidly. 

“I still think you should hold off on entering a loveless marriage and letting some alpha mating bite you..” Cifera told him, sounding more and more exasperated as they rehashed this topic again and again, “You can find love again, and Kremnos isn’t in that dire of a situation currently to need to marry you off.” 

Mydei had already thought of that though - and he had to admit his rush was a bit intentional as he huffed a small laugh, “Mm.. The faster I have someone bite on my neck the faster I can forget all those stupid promises I hoped for and move on.”

Cifera was silent for a moment, a long one, all before she gave a deep and rather loud sigh, “Well.. Let’s sober up first before saying things like that, okay?”

“I don’t need to sober up, I’m going back home a failure either way.” Mydei instantly fired back with a small chuckle as he closed his eyes - doing his best to drown out the way he felt so hopeless now. 

His chance at love was gone, the only man he had ever wanted a deep personal relationship with had moved on, and now he had to as well. 

“What do you mean?" Cifera innocently asked, blissfully unaware of the fate Mydei had laid out for himself. To free himself, in a way, to succumb to fate and just let life continue on.

Thus, he could only laugh again and open his eyes slowly, “I told Queen Gorgo that if I fail to sway Phainon this time, she may immediately begin looking for a mate for me upon my arrival in Kremnos.”

“Oh..” Cifera started, sounding so very stunned as she tried to figure out what to say to that, “You’re..”

Mydei moved to copy her pose - now leaning on his own elbows on that railing as he blinked upwards as the sky, laughing a little over how stupid he was to have always believed in Phainon’s words. They were just kids, after all. Phainon owed him nothing, and growing apart was natural. It was his own stupidity that led him to being hurt, not Phainon.

“Doomed to a loveless marriage if she finds someone willing to take me, you could say.” Mydei mumbled with his own thoughts, giving a laugh over how that sounded like it would be a struggle. He knew he wasn’t many people’s cup of tea in regards to physique for omegas.

.. All he had going for him was his family name, and someone that may have an odd kink for beefier omegas, he guessed.

“.. Let’s go get you another glass of wine, okay?”

“Yep.”
