Chapter Notes

Hello!
Please read the tags: I was not jking about the yandere tag in this fic, usually it is off screen but I wrote the murder in detail this time and was begged not to delete it kkirfdeskigrfksde.

“Phainon,” Phainon jerked his head upwards at that - eyes moving to the girl who was walking into his room by knocking on the side of his bedroom wall lazily, “You have mail from Kremnos.” Cyrene told him with a fond smile gracing her lips - looking as elegant as ever as she approached with that small envelope in hand.

Phainon couldn’t even try to stop the way he had immediately jolted up and off his bed either, throwing his sword to the side as he gave up on cleaning it in favor of reading that letter. Decorated in gold and red, a clear mark of the royal Kremnoan family that made his hands tremble slightly as he took it from her gingerly.

Unable to stop the curiosity burning into his skull as he inspected it, all before blinking up at Cyrene for answers on the matter; “Kremnos? Mydeimos?”

Cyrene could only shrug her shoulders since, after all, she had never been rude enough to go through Phainon’s mail. And Phainon respected that about her! It was very sweet of her, really. 

“I assume so. It’s quite the fancy letter.” Cyrene replied in a chilled voice, relaxed and calm as always - a stark contrast to the nervousness Phainon was feeling over this letter right now. 

“Mm.. Let me see.” Phainon hummed as he moved his nails to messily open that letter - he had never been very good at neatly breaking those wax seals with the Kremnos sigil on it, but that wasn’t the point. 

Instead Phainon moved deft fingers to set that envelope down on his bed and unfold that parchment paper to read it.

But he didn’t need to read far, not at all as his thoughts paused in his mind - leaving him staring at that paper uselessly. Repeating them again and again until they made more sense, but they never did. How could they? 

“He..” Phainon choked out, feeling the way his throat was closing in on itself as he even tried to utter those words - eyes feeling misty as the reality of it all washed over him in horrible waves of agony,  “He’s to be wedded.”

His mind felt wracked already, horrible and empty as he moved his hand to his head - fingers clawing as his scalp before taking a few steps back to sit back on his bed. Not paying his sword a single glance as he continued reading over those paragraphs again and again. Letters that were mocking him and clawing at his skin, squeezing and torturing his heart as he understood it.

Mydei was actually entering an arranged marriage. 

Cyrene was silent for too many beats of a second, all before saying a quiet singular word; “.. Huh?”

“To Prince Parmenides.” Phainon replied instantly, though his eyes were on reading those same letters again and again - tracing over them with his eyes until they lost meaning and became nothing. Only to read them more and more after that fact, not caring that they had turned to mush and gibberish.

Only caring that it meant Mydeimos was trying to leave him, giving up permanently on their dreams as children and cute promises. Surely they meant nothing to him? Did Phainon mean nothing to him as well?

He couldn’t accept that.

He didn’t want to accept that, either.

All he knew was the fact his hands were trembling, shaking even more as he crumbled that paper slightly due to his erratic emotions - unable to stop the grinding of his teeth against his gums until he tasted his own copper blood on his tastebuds. Just to grind them more, trying to make the pain anchor him down to reality in this situation. 

“Who is that?” Cyrene asked, and that’s when Phainon snapped back to this realm - realizing how futile it was as he felt detached from his own body. Only able to stare at her with wide eyes as he tried to process the question.

Who is that?

Prince Parmenides?

Who even is that?

“.. I don’t know.” Phainon answered his own thoughts  and Cyrene - trying to hold himself together, all while failing horribly. 

Phainon had to choke out a bitter and hollow laugh - feeling sour and vile on his tongue, heavy in his own mouth as he only scratched himself more and more as he tried to understand this all. 

Cyrene leaned against the door frame - arms crossing over her frilly pink dress that made Phainon aware of the crinkly noises of the fabric. Muted and distant, yet somehow ringing in his ears along with her words she sighed out as well over the situation. 

“Wow.. I honestly didn’t think he would.. Marry anyone but you.. I’m shocked by this news..” Cyrene conceded, and Phainon couldn’t even bring himself to look at her.

He also thought that.

He thought they were soulmates, born into this world to be connected deeply forever - at each other’s side and comforting each other no matter what. Hand in hand, mated no matter their secondary genders and now.

.. He was being thrown aside like a broken toy, yet he couldn’t even find it in his heart to be angry at Mydei. Only able to seethe in his own rage and jealousy at that other prince he had never met before in his entire life in this world.

Phainon had to shake his head over her words - trying not to think about how much he agreed with them and how hurt he was. It didn’t matter.

He just had to prove himself, after all..; “.. It’s an arranged marriage.”

That didn’t mean Mydei loved him.

It didn’t mean there were feelings that were unbreakable there, a bond that was too strong, that meant that Mydei was settling for this man. Doing it for reasons outside of merely love, even though he had always hated the idea of doing that when they were younger. Always eager to accept Phainon’s silly flower rings and wear them until they wilted to promise himself to him.

And now..

He was allowing himself to be unhappy.. Wasn’t he? Arranged marriages weren’t love. 

“Gorgo set it up, then?” Cyrene asked, but Phainon found himself moving his eyes across the letter again, trying to understand why she would do this to him.

Why would Queen Gorgo be so fine with it all, or had Mydei already told his mother that they no longer had any bond for her to be worried about - even though she had laughed and scolded Phainon when they were younger. Telling him time and time again that if he wanted her son, he had to be able to love him deeper than anyone else, and wield his sword better than his other competitors for his hand as well.

.. Phainon had agreed to those terms, time and time again just the same. 

“.. I believe so.”

Cyrene was silent over those words - seeming like she didn’t know at all how to comfort her sibling as she remained a few steps away. Not daring to enter his  rather regal bedroom in the Okhema palace, yet.. 

“You seem.. Exceptionally angry, please take some time to cool down, alright?” Cyrene inquired, making Phainon’s eyes finally leave that parchment. Furrowing his brows as he realized his scent must easily be souring into something putrid.

He didn’t actually think he cared however, not even as his eyes trailed over her slightly scrunched up nose over the way he was throwing off pheromones in waves.

He couldn’t help it, and he didn’t see a point in even trying to mask his emotions, anyway: “It’s next week.”

“So soon?” She asked innocently, shaking her head just a bit as if she hadn’t expected it either, so quickly and rushed. Like the crown prince of Kremnos was doing his best to get a mate as soon as possible.

Was Mydei desperate?

Phainon couldn’t understand why if so, because why not as Phainon? He would be his mate today, right this second? Why was he striving to marry this man instead?

“I..” Phainon coughed out a hoarse set of laughter as his thoughts only became more tangled, tripping over them in his own mind again and again, “Mydeimos is going to wed the alpha prince named Parmenides..?”

Phainon found himself unable to stop the way he kept giggling, maniac and stressed as they left his throat - bile threatening to burn in their wake just the same. And all he could do was rub a hand in his hair - trying to understand.

“Mydei.. Will become this person’s mate? Next week?”

Mydei was going to be someone else’s mate? For the rest of his life? Spending his days at his side and never seeing Phainon again outside of formal events? Always remaining cold and reserved like he had acted at Cyrene’s birthday party mere days ago?

.. How was this fair?

“.. Are you alright, Phainon?” Cyrene asked, but that did nothing to help him - only making him tilt his head as his eyes fell on her. Blankly staring at her as he tried to process it. Was he alright?

How could he be?

He.. 

“I just don’t understand.” Phainon told her as he dropped his hand from his head, using it to wave his thoughts away dismissively; “He brought it up, you know? That he might be entering an arranged marriage soon, but for some reason I.. Didn’t believe him.”

How could he ever believe him?

They had been best friends all their life, and Phainon had always made it so blatantly obvious that he wanted to be more. That he wanted to marry Mydei, mate with him, and wake up daily with that man at his side happily - and now.

That future was being robbed from him?

That wasn’t fair. It couldn’t be fair at all.

“I thought I had more time, more chances to keep trying to worm my way back into his life and instead I’m..” Phainon was rambling, he knew he was - but as he crumbled up that invitation more to hide his hands, what else could he do but sputter out his broken words? “Getting the door not shut in my face, but slammed. A door that is permanent..” Phainon mumbled, trying his best to grasp at the last strings of his sanity, but even that felt like it was unraveling.

Everything was falling apart, and he had to figure out how to stop it.

How?

“What am I going to do..?” Phainon asked, his voice failing him and falling into a pathetic whisper as he came to terms with the fact that he didn’t know.

What was he supposed to do in this situation? He couldn’t see himself just letting go of his oldest friend and the man he had already promised his entire heart to, so what could he do now?

“Will you attend the wedding?”

Phainon slowly raised his head up, not even aware he had allowed it to fall dejectedly as he moved his eyes to look at her egregiously. Slowly tilting his head to the side as he considered that question. “Attend..?” He echoed out, no more than a small almost inaudible whisper as it left his lungs painfully. 

Lips feeling dry and cracked as he moved to bite into them - tearing at his own flesh on top of them slowly. Gnawing them raw as he blinked at Cyrene who seemed almost uncomfortable - shifting her weight between her feet now as a look of worry only grew on her face. 

“To support him? He obviously wants you to at least be in his life in some capacity.” Cyrene told him with a voice as soft as a feather, delicate and full of care - but it fell on Phainon like an anvil.

The idea that Mydei either wanted him in his life still, somehow, or the idea that Mydei just was inviting him to let him fully watch his life crumble. To watch the person he loved the most slip away from him, and have nothing to do with him ever again in a romantic sense.

.. It was cruel, but Phainon could only press out a heavy exhale, thumb rubbing that crumbled paper idly to feel it under calloused fingers.

“I.. Guess I have to but..” Phainon murmured, moving his eyes back to that damned paper while feeling a seeping void entering his stomach, “I love him, Cyrene..”

“I’m sorry..” Cyrene replied immediately, sounding like she truly understood because what else was she to say when she had known for so long of his love and devotion for that man? His adoration reached the darkest depths, only for Mydei to move on regardless of that fact. 

Phainon found himself tracing over those golden inked letters numbly with his fingers - as if that would help him come to terms with them. “I love him so much, more than anything else and I.. I have to say good bye? Good bye to the man I love and watch someone else take him from me?” He found himself babbling - eyes focusing wholly on that letter.

And he wasn’t even sure if he wanted to laugh or cry anymore, but whatever it was, he knew it was choking him so harshly. 

“I.. I’ll leave you to grieve alone.” Cyrene eventually found the words, seeming more and more stunned over it all. Shuffling oddly as she moved to shake her head, not in disapproval or disappointment - merely seeming as if she had no idea what to say.

Phainon didn’t know what to say either, honestly.

“Thank you.”

“Take care of yourself, okay? I’ll be in the gardens if you need me.”

Phainon didn’t think he needed anyone right now - not unless it was Mydei being willing to comfort him, to say it was a fluke, a mistake. An error of fancy golden writing in Queen Gorgo’s own handwriting.. 

But it wasn’t, was it?

Mydei was really moving on. Replacing him and their memories together with someone else, someone more permanent that Phainon would never be able to rival if they went through with it. The thought alone was enough to make Phainon drag his hands through his hair - combing it back worryingly before moving on to scratching at his arm.

What was he supposed to do now?

If he hesitated, Mydei would forever be out of his reach - allowing someone into his bed and claiming him so deeply in a way that Phainon could never compete with. 

But what was he to do?

What could he do?

Beg Mydei not to marry that prince? Plead with his mother directly for her to call it off for Mydei, and to give Phainon a chance to prove his love?

Even with their good relationship from his childhood around the Kremnoan royal family, he highly doubted that Gorgo would ruin an arrangement already. And Mydei himself seemed less than interested in him..

Troubling and bothersome and so very heavy on his shoulders as he moved to stand up in his room. Not even sure of what he was going to do, not processing his own thoughts fully as his hands moved to look at that letter again - taking in the kingdom’s name as he moved to put his sword back into its sheathe at his side.

All while his feet walked briskly without much of a thought in his mind.

At the very least, no one ever questioned the sword on Phainon’s waist - always there for protection, but now..

He felt as though he needed to use it for Mydei’s sake. To show him that alpha wasn’t enough, that he couldn’t compare to Phainon in this scenario, that the alpha he was choosing would undoubtedly lose that fight brutally.

“Cyrene.” Phainon visibly watched his sister jolt over that, no longer hunched over a bush of roses and sniping away at them as her favorite hobby - now blinking widely at her sibling.

All before giving a rather toothy smile - a warm one that had always been comforting to Phainon, but now, all he could feel was the sickening and heavy dread in his stomach that was sitting uncomfortably like a stone in his chest. All threatening to boil over, and Phainon wasn’t sure that he had the will to even try to stop it. 

“Phainon? Are you doing well?”

Phainon shook his head over that, slow and precise as he tried to think about it all - tried to conceal the way he was unraveling so quickly at the seams, “I’m fine, I’m just.. Going to turn in early for today - please.. Don’t allow myself to be disturbed for the rest of the night, if possible.”

A lie.

A lie to make her leave him alone for the rest of the day and night, he had never lied to his sister before, and now he was standing here trying to smile as he said those words. Trying to lie through his own teeth as his lips quivered with his own emotions choking him.

Cyrene knit her brows over that rather obviously - looking like she wanted to say something, but the words were failing her; “I’ll do my best.. Take care, Phainon.”

Phainon didn’t reply to that - couldn’t reply to that when he needed to go. He had to leave, his feet moved on their own as he pulled his stark blue hood over his head - huffing as he borrowed a horse from the stables - and made his way to a kingdom he had never been to before.

Foreign.

Cold and distant. 

Phainon found himself walking those unfamiliar halls mindlessly - blinking around the passage ways as surprisingly no one stopped to question him as nightfall fell. Probably due to his rather regal clothing that he was still wearing - looking sleek and proper like he belonged to this kingdom easily. 

Not much of a disguise going on, even as the time passed and minutes turned to hours while he slowly stalked behind a man he had never met before. Not formally. A man he had only learned was the person he hated the most by a passing conversation - a merry little sing-song tune of his name from a woman wanting his attention. Praising their prince on his upcoming marriage.

And that was merely more salt into Phainon’s open wounds, burning him and making his skin crawl over the way this man was gloating over it. Gloating over claiming the Kremnoan prince for himself, and being the one ‘brave enough to be willing to accept Mydei’.

As if that was a hard thing to accomplish at all with how sweet that alpha was, a gentle and kind man who didn’t deserve these people’s filthy tongues soiling his name. 

Parmenides.

Phainon hated that name, not for any specific reason, merely due to the fact it belonged to the alpha stealing his Mydeimos away from him. And Phainon only found himself doing his best to stay in the shadows, moving silently as hiding away in corners due to his bright hair that sorely stuck out - but the hood would only make him appear more shady.

But it didn’t matter.

Not a single sword in sight, no weapons at all, these people did not even consider the fact they could be attacked at any moment. Only gleefully living out their days and schmoozing with each other in circles. 

A piece of him was almost worried that they would be able to remember him being here, point him out and say it was him once he was done here. But he didn’t know if he quite cared anymore as he continued his prowling after this man - feeling more and more glad as nightfall came with parting hour.

Humming a bit quietly to himself, all the way in time with the heavy footfalls of a prince who clearly had no training in being silent and undetected. A prince who seemed to know no struggles of war, or knew of any enemies. A good candidate for love, but not for the prince from the kingdom bent on war always. 

A horrible match for his beloved Mydei, that much was obvious as Phainon chuckled a bit darkly - drinking in the way the man turned swiftly to blink at him. Alone in the vast hallway that seemed to stretch for such a long time.

“Hello? You are not supposed to be here.” That alpha pointed out without much tact or grace, and for some reason Phainon found himself cocking his head to the side over that. Another mark against this annoying man, all while his voice grinded at Phainon’s ears some more; “These halls lead to the private royal quarters, you are not to come any further.”

Phainon felt himself clench his jaw over that - feeling his hand twitch at his side all before he laughed over it. Over how carefree this man was to assume Phainon was just someone lost that needed a deep scolding. 

Like he was a child, not even fit to be his competition for Mydei’s hand..

Annoying.

“Why would you simply tell someone that? Do you have a deathwish for your entire family as well?” Phainon asked, giving a small little laugh, a broken thing that didn’t settle right in his own mouth. Tasting of vile lies and false promises that were twisting his heart now. 

And that alpha merely looked as if he had been insulted, furrowing his brows and tutting. 

“Pardon me?”

Pardon him?

Phainon shrugged over that, “There are no guards anywhere in the castle that I’ve seen. Why is that?”

That alpha only took on such a pissy little pose - crossing his arms over his chest and pursing his lips as if he was bothered by Phainon. And sure, sure.. He should be, but he seemed bothered for the wrong reasons. Too unexpecting that he could possibly ever be in danger. 

“Everyone who enters here is vetted thoroughly, just like you.”

Phainon found himself chuckling over that yet again, “You’re the first person I’ve spoken to since arriving in this kingdom, actually.”

That prince looked a little shocked, just for a moment before narrowing his eyes - as if he was unimpressed, “Am I? Then you must go speak to the guards and file your paperwork. Off you go now.”

And Phainon couldn’t help but stare at those brown eyes and golden hair, making Phainon wonder if Mydei liked blond hair so much that he even liked his partners with it.. Was Phainon’s white hair a dealbreaker? 

No.. That was too shallow, his Mydei wasn’t like that. 

“Off I go now, he says.” Phainon mumbled out instead, shaking his head very slowly over the foolishness on display right in front of him - insane enough as ever.

And the alpha prince who was betrothed to Phainon’s love of his life only huffed out defiantly over that sight; “Are you.. Mocking me?”

“No.. I’m just amused.” Phainon hummed out - all while moving his hand to take the hilt of his blade. Leisurely moving it from its sheathe in a fluid motion, “Though, I probably am mocking you just a little if I’m being honest.”

“W-What are you doing?”

Phainon flicked his eyes up that man, all before moving to place the blade of his sword in his own hand while the other held onto that hilt of it. Turning it idly to look at the cold metal that burned against his own skin, all before slashing it idly back to his side lazily. 

“Merely showing you my blade - its craftsmanship is superb in an extremely delicate and intricate way.” Phainon said in a tone so icy it burned even his own ears, unfamiliar and distant compared to how he normally sounded that he couldn’t even blame that poor frightened alpha when he took a step back as Phainon took one forward.

Even if that was silly, making Phainon chuckle just a tiny bit, “Don’t step away, I’m merely trying to show you.”

That didn’t seem to coax him however, instead..

That alpha quickly turned to flee, almost too fast to where Phainon found himself bubbling out a laugh over the situation - all before lunging at that man with a fierce movement. Not wanting him to escape at all, no matter what he went.

Phainon would hunt him.

It didn’t matter anyways as Phainon easily tackled the man, causing him to topple over all while Phainon’s agile training allowed them to avoid copying. 

“Goodness! You can run almost fast!” Phainon said as he blinked at the man who was trying to scurry to his feet again beneath him. All while Phainon tilted his head to watch the attempt, lop-sided smile on his face, teeth feeling too big for his own jaw, smile too quirked and shaky, unnatural. And yet he smiled as he spoke: “Almost. It was pretty boring.”

“Stop-” Phainon didn't, however, not pausing a single moment as he stabbed his own sword into the calves of one of that man’s legs. A sickening crunch as he drove it home, and he felt a little amused over the way he tried to scream over it - such a pathetic sound that was fueled by panic and adrenaline. It almost made Phainon wonder where the people were to aid their prince..? 

So close to their royal quarters, and yet not one came - even as Phainon stood there and waited, only to stare at that man whimpering with shaky hands. Body contorted oddly to look at that blade in his own legs and press around his skin where the sword had dug into him savagely. Blood staining his own fingers over that action - all before his eyes snapped up to Phainon.

“Please! What do you want?! Take it out please!”

Ah.

Begging for his life, even though Phainon wasn’t sure his life, or the begging, was worth much anymore.

“I didn’t come here to kill you, you know? Originally, at least..” Phainon explained, blinking as his mind trailed back to the way those people had spoken about Mydei. As if this man was making a sacrifice by accepting his proposal, and wasn’t joyous at all to have him. 

Jealousy. 

Jealousy and seething agony were brewing in Phainon’s heart over it all. His precious best friend and man he had promised himself to was settling for a man who held no love for him. Talked about him to people like he was some burden for him to struggle with, and was praised for it. 

“It’s odd. It’s like I just can’t stop myself from getting more and more angry with you.” Phainon added on, feeling himself shrug and laugh a little darkly. A horribly cracked and jaded noise as he considered the situation he was in now. A sword through this prince’s leg, and a Mydei who didn’t love him.

Not yet.

Phainon could only watch as that man moved on to panting raggedly - nerves eating him alive as he tried to figure out how to escape. Going as far to try to pull his own leg out and cry out as he caused himself more pain.

And Phainon sighed over the sight, “You won’t even try to fight back.. You’re just a rat trying to escape so you can scavenge and live like trash.” 

It was odd, though. Why was he not yelling more for help? Crying and begging for someone to come save him?

Did no one truly wander these halls? Was their kingdom so stupid that they thought they had no enemies at all while their prince was marrying the crown prince of Kremnos?

.. Well, Phainon supposed they would learn today that they did in fact have one enemy due to that marriage. 

Phainon could only wistfully sigh over his own thoughts, “Meanwhile..” Phainon took a moment to kick a foot lazily into that leg - making sure he was nice and speared to the floor while he spoke. After all, Phainon did want all of that alpha’s attention on him so he could fully learn about the alpha he couldn’t compare to.

Not in this life, not when it came to loving and adoring Mydeimos.

“I took a lot of classes in self defense as a child and teenager.” Phainon explained with a happy little smirk over it all - pacing a little as he spoke, “It became a rather big interest in my life, honestly.”

Those memories were some of the best.

Trapped in a room with only Mydei to talk to for hours, bonding and laughing in between their spars. Wrestling and getting sweaty while enjoying each other’s company, all under the guise of training for when they both were adults and needed to protect themselves, and their kingdoms.

But Phainon had only wanted to protect that man, most of all.

He adored his kingdom to pieces, and was unrelentingly thankful to them - he would do anything for them. He merely.. Had assumed Mydei would be here at his side as well. 

“I loved sparring with him, and spending my afternoons at his side..” Phainon hummed, leaning his head to the side as he took in the sight of blood spilling from that wound still, “Only for you..”

Phainon felt his face turn into a snarl, angry beyond repair as he sneered at that alpha on the floor beneath him disgustingly. 

“To have his scent on you.” Phainon darkly growled out, feeling his own rage seep into his words as he took a step closer towards that alpha. Truthfully, he wasn’t quite sure if that was Mydei’s scent, or if his own mind was betraying him with his mounting hatred for this person.

But all he did know was how deeply he enjoyed the sight of this pest crawling on the floor, stumbling a bit backwards as he seemed to weep a little.

As much as he could due to Phainon’s sword still lodged into his leg cruelly, pathetically already whimpering and crying over just that tiny wound pinning him down, “W-Who?”

“Who?” Phainon echoed out mockingly, cocking his head to the side as he kneeled down - just a little to tap at the blade still stuck in the alpha’s leg, “Who, I wonder?”

Phainon couldn’t stop himself as he leaned forward - hand grabbing at that man’s chin as he gripped him harshly, feeling the way he was sobbing and heaving to take in breaths of air. 

“Mydeimos. Surely you know that name, don’t you? Have you kissed him with this tainted mouth as well to have his scent on you?” Phainon asked - fingers gripping the hilt of his blade to cruelly sway it side to side, digging into that man’s leg just a bit more to savor the way he tried to jerk and wail out of Phainon’s hand on his chin. Only to go nowhere as Phainon tightened his fingers on his skin, pressing deeply into that jaw of his.

A jaw that had grazed against Mydei’s skin, a jaw that didn’t deserve to be anywhere near Phainon’s prince in the first place. 

“I-” 

Phainon found himself squeezing even harder on that man’s chin - fingers forcing him into silence as his cheeks were pressed into his own teeth, unable to speak.

“I didn’t say I cared for your replies, haven’t you taken enough from me already..? I don’t need you making my mood even worse with your horrid voice in my ears.” Phainon couldn’t help but stare into the man’s eyes, basking in the way he knew he felt hopeless and lost.

Just like he had made Phainon feel by stealing Mydei away from him, stealing the only thing that had always made him happy in his life and the one person he had always looked forward to seeing. The man he had promised himself to, and now had to fight and claw his way back into his heart.

Phainon wasn’t big on violence, but as he tightened his hold on that sword and watched more tears fall out of Mydei’s fiance’s eyes - He felt like he could become accustomed to that sickening feeling in his stomach. 

Anything was worth Mydeimos, he knew that much as the heavy weight in his stomach considered actually losing that man. And that felt so much more painful than the guilt of killing this alpha as Phainon’s hand clamped harder on that man’s jaw. Just to savor the way he was struggling to try to get Phainon’s hand off of him. 

His own blood smeared wetly against Phainon’s wrist to make his own grip fail him uselessly, such a futile attempt that Phainon could only click his tongue and shake his head slowly. 

“Such a weak alpha.. And you assumed yourself good enough for my Mydeimos?” Phainon inquired innocently - blinking wide eyes over the way that alpha was making such pathetic and odd noises from his throat. Clearly wishing to escape Phainon and plead for help from someone.

“If you’re good and can fight me off with your own strength.. I’ll let you live, deal?” Phainon cooed out, letting go of his face leisurely all before dragging his sword out of that man’s leg as well. Just to stand there and watch the way he began to hurriedly try to crawl away.

Making Phainon tilt his head to the side - all while calmly treading behind the man with his sword trailing behind him. Metal on the stone flooring wailed loudly in his ears as it dragged blood behind him, but the sound of metal wasn’t as loud as that man was. 

“Help! Help me, someone t-”

Phainon didn’t waste a single moment before plunging his sword straight down and through that man’s spine lazily - listening to the way his sword sunk into skin and sinew ripping him apart. All before moving his own foot so swiftly to jam the front of his boot into his mouth. Muffling the scream that had ripped from his throat over the sharp pain running through body.

Not that Phainon cared as he stood there for a moment, blinking and waiting for him to be done with that all before removing his boot with a heavy and exasperated sigh.

“Your own strength. That does not mean to cry and wail for a savior.” Phainon murmured out as he crouched down - enough to look at that man who was still scraping at the floor for an escape. Leaving messy blood trails in the wake of his dented finger nails, “Mydeimos is precious to me.. Any alpha that he expects to become his mate should be able to fight off their competition as well.”

That much made sense.

If Mydei wanted to replace Phainon, they would at least have to prove that they could defeat him in a fight of strength and will! Though.. This one hadn’t been given a weapon to defend himself.. That was his own fault, wasn’t it?

As a prince you should be on guard at all times, ready to defend yourself from attackers.. And to defend your mate!

What a useless alpha this prince was if he didn’t even carry a sword on his to use in defense of Mydei if the time called for it.. Phainon had to assume he was doing Mydei a favor here with this, savoring the way that alpha’s breathing seemed to be growing more and more ragged as Phainon watched him.

“You’ve simply failed that challenge, that’s all. It’s nothing personal.” Phainon tutted over his own words - shaking his head over the way that man was still trying to scratch at the floor - pinned like a bug by the sword through his back, “Ah, but I’m lying.. I really hate you, you know?” Phainon confessed.

It was true, anyway.

He adored Mydei, adored and loved him to hell and back. Yet Mydei…

“He matters so much to me, yet he picked you first..” Phainon asked, feeling his voice crack with his own heavy emotions flooding his words - unable to understand it at all,  “Why?”

Why?

Why wasn’t he Mydei’s first pick, or second pick? How far down the list was Phainon for Mydei’s hand in marriage? How far until Phainon was considered an option for love for Mydei?

His body was strong, sturdy above all else, and Mydei himself used to say they were equals when they were younger - so why could he not be considered as Mydei’s mate..?

Phainon could only put his head in his hands and groan so loudly over his erratic thoughts running wild in his skull; “I can be a good alpha to him.. I’ll be so gentle and loving.. Or rough if he wants..” 

Phainon found himself scratching at his face - rubbing himself tiredly before barking out an odd laugh, borderline growling the noise out as it burned his throat. Such an odd noise that it physically stung to make it. 

“Yet he..” Phainon paused, staring at the way that alpha’s chest had stopped moving, making Phainon tilt his head as he fully inspected him, “Hello? Have you passed away mid conversation?”

Phainon moved to tap his foot into the side of that body again - waiting for any signs of life over that. Just to press a sigh out when he was given absolutely nothing in return, not even a quiet dying wheeze or a cough of blood. Just irritable silence with Phainon’s own thoughts clawing at his mind in the emptiness.

“That’s rather rude of you..” Phainon murmured, boredly prying his sword out of that man’s back with a rather daunting squelching of blood following after his blade.

Phainon couldn’t stop the tremble in his hands - staring at the man who now laid at his feet. 

Staring all while that blood puddle pooled and grew around his feet - staining his shoes in crimson as his eyes stared at the back of that alpha. Taking in the sight of how he had stopped breathing, no longer struggling or trying to get away. Merely laying there suffocating and leaving this world by choking on his own blood.

And all Phainon could do was try to grip onto his sword tightly, try to settle his dying down rage as he took a step away - not even caring that his shoes would leave a trail. He would leave them elsewhere before he got some, and none would be any wiser.

But in those dimly lit halls where an alpha left this realm, he only found himself to be slightly giddy over the way it was done. Sure.. There was now blood caked onto his hands, sword, and boots - but at least another obstacle blocking his path to Mydei was cleared. 

.. All he had to do now was get home, clean off, and act as if he had never slaughtered an alpha on this moonlit night - footfalls as light as a feather now that the heavy weight was off of his heart. 

Phainon would be a good friend, after all, and comfort Mydei in his time of mourning over his murdered potential mate.

“How are you holding up, Mydei?”

Mydei had to move to rub his face with his hands - shaking his head slowly as he thought about it more and more. Trying his best to control himself and his laughter over how strange this situation was unfolding to be, more and more things gave him questions. 

“.. I’m fine. We barely knew each other.” Mydei mumbled out after a few moments, dropping his hands over that as he leaned into his chair a little. Doing his best to not think too much about the horrifying thing that kept haunting him.

No matter how much he tried to ignore it. 

“Mm.. Have they already questioned you?” Cifera asked rather innocently, probably because it was an innocent question - spoken in such a hushed tone due to being at a funeral that Mydei.. 

He had to sigh over it.

Mydei kept his eyes locked ahead, moving to cross his arms over his chest as he stared at that casket that was having flowers left at it still.

Questioned.

About who would assassinate the man that was supposed to marry and mate with Mydei.

Mydei had no idea. 

“My entire family as well.”

Cifera seemed to readjust her weight over that, idly swaying a little in her chair before choosing out what to say apparently; “.. Understandable, but I’ve never heard of anyone who was so vehemently against Kremnos that they would murder your suitor.”

Cifera gave an oddly choked noise over something all before moving to stand a bit abruptly, chair rattling a little under her quick movements, “.. Speaking of enemies, please excuse me for a bit, Prince Mydeimos.”

Faint, like he barely had touched him, so close to being nothing that Mydei knew Phainon had been quick about meeting him.

.. Or perhaps he just didn’t want people to know he had met with Parmenides at all - whatever the case may truly be, Mydei had to huff over it.

“Ah. I see.” Mydei grumbled as that man strode towards him - eyes seeming focused on the leaving Cifera before moving to Mydei. Horribly moving away from each other as Phainon fell deeper for assumedly Aglaea, and Mydei tried to find his own love. 

But that was just fate, wasn’t it?

“Prince Phainon.” Mydei replied, just as coldly as his eyes moved to focus on that casket again - not caring to look at the alpha who was now leaning almost into Mydei. As if he desired the closeness, or was trying to use his scent to calm Mydei.

“I’m.. Very sorry for your loss.”

“Thank you.”

Moving his arms to cross them over his chest and lean into that odd metal chair they had set up in rows. Blaming them for their prince’s death, and barely allowing Mydei to be here.

.. He didn’t even dare to question how Phainon had been allowed to attend when his scent was on that corpse buried under perfumes and the like.

Forgotten, well-loved, and decaying along with the passage of time. And Mydei could only fear it was probably the same case for his usefulness to Phainon, anyway.

.. And Mydei wished he could say the same about those flowers on his own shelf.

.. But he was oddly used to that by Phainon, considering the fact he had always looked at Mydei in such an odd and primal way when he assumed Mydei didn’t notice him doing it.

What else was he supposed to want?

.. A trail of blood that seemed so unhurried that people were talking about how the murderer seemed much too cold and calculated - not caring at all if they were caught.

“Another..” Phainon repeated, jarring Mydei from his own thoughts to throw an odd stare at the way he sounded like he was being choked in that soft whispered voice.
