“You really just.. Want any alpha? Not being specific at all about it?” Phainon asked, seeming wholly unaware of his own scent souring - or he simply didn’t care about that right now. 

“Why bother?” Mydei asked, trying his best to keep his voice from rising in volume as he felt himself grow more and more stressed - especially as new eyes were falling on them, “You.. Your scent is rather horrid, Phainon. Are you alright?”

Phainon stiffened at that - so rigidly that Mydei for the first time in a long time had to bite back a small laugh over the way he looked like a spooked puppy, all before Phainon huffed a little and relaxed himself; “Is it? My apologies, Mydeimos..”

Mydei had to sigh, feeling the urge to laugh with Phainon pass and once again be replaced with the misery that was the reality of the situation. The simple fact that it was him, again and again, angering the alpha he cherished more than anyone else. The same man he wanted nothing more than to soothe with his own scent. 

Instead, he could only stand up out of his seat languidly, “.. I’ll give you some space.”

“Wait, It’s not you. You don’t have to leave.” Phainon immediately hissed out, sounding almost panicked but Mydei only had to shake his head over that. 

“Right. And it’s just the other person in the conversation upsetting you? Please excuse me, Prince Phainon.” Mydei huffed to him, looking severely unimpressed at the man who now looked akin to a kicked puppy who was sopping wet. As if this was the worst news he had gotten this week.

.. And they were at a funeral Phainon had been invited to, so Mydei really doubted that was actually the case.

“Mydei..” Phainon whimpered out in an odd whiny tone - one that Mydei was more than a little immune to due to their teenage years and also he just.. 

Didn’t wait to hear it - instead moving quickly to find the alpha who was lurking now in the back area. Clearly not keen on being in the vicinity while Phainon was growling and getting annoyed at Mydei, and he couldn’t blame her over that.

Especially not as Cifera shook his head at his arrival: “Why is the princely boy so stinky? Doesn’t he know he’s at a funeral? He smells like he’s trying to mark his territory over everyone here..”

Mydei had to huff over that, a little thankful to be moving closer to Cifera to smell the lighter tones of a less angry alpha. Dull and lessened due to her own scent blockers to match Mydei’s, but certainly a welcomed presence in his life all the same. 

“I spoke about just wanting to be accepted by someone and he got upset at me.” Mydei explained, huffing a little as he refused to cast a glance at the alpha who was undoubtedly still seated where he had left him.

Most likely trying to rein in his scent now that it had been pointed out.. 

Cifera scrunched her face over that - her own eyes flickering to a spot behind him to where Mydei was quite sure that’s where Phainon was all before darting right back to Mydei. Only to scoff a little; “.. He’s that mad about it?”

“He doesn’t seem fond of me at all, nowadays.” Mydei told her with a small little exhale leaving him that he hadn’t even meant to let out. Probably out of his own frustration and sorrow, but he couldn’t mope and whine over the alpha he loved not wanting him for all his life. He had to move on, “Even the idea of me having a happy ending seems to force him into smelling like an angered alpha.”

Cifera shuffled her weight over that - idly moving between her feet as she let out a quiet humming noise; “Surely it’s not that.. Maybe he’s jealous?”

Jealous..?

“Of what? He already rejected me. He has nothing to be jealous of.” Mydei pointed out with a shake of his head, after all, he had anguished over that rejection for such a long time and spent enough time in mourning alone.

The idea of that alpha caring was beyond him, he knew where he stood in that man’s life - even if Phainon himself seemed uncertain of where to squeeze Mydei in. 

“Maybe he didn’t think you were going to move on so quickly.” Cifera tried, but that only made Mydei move to cross his arms, leaning on one leg a little as he tried to consider that.

“So he wanted me to just keep moping over it? I already had spent weeks mourning whatever promises he made to me as children.” Mydei pointed out with a quiet sigh leaving his lips - doing his best to remain respectful and level while at a funeral. A funeral that he was barely even allowed into already, “That’s all they were. Silly dreams and words between two kids, and I was the foolish one for believing in them.”

Cifera pursed her lips - only for a brief second before seeming lily she was trying to figure out what to say to comfort him. All before giving up on the hopeless case that was known as Mydei’s love life probably, “I don’t know.. Maybe he’s oddly territorial over you?”

“I doubt that. I told you about how upset he got over me going anywhere near that alpha he’s in love with.” Mydei argued, ignoring the way Cifera looked like she had something to say with her eyes flickering around wildly.

All before Mydei learned first hand while she had been looking as if something was bothering her - and it most likely had something to do with that approaching alpha coming back already to chase Mydei down.

“Mydei!”

Mydei had to stiffen over his name being said so loudly at a funeral, not really daring to look behind him as he breathed out a shallow breath. One that felt way more constricting than freeing. 

“Speak of the devil..” Cifera murmured, making Mydei turn just ever so slightly, not like that was needed as Phainon’s hands immediately found their way to his shoulders from behind. Laying there as the alpha moved to his side so quickly - eyes twinkling as he beamed a smile to Mydei.  But even that felt so cold and precise, especially with those hands that almost felt like they were on Mydei’s shoulders for a purpose.

.. Mydei would almost think he was being scented by the alpha if he didn’t already know better.

“You left so quickly! Let’s talk some more, yeah?” Phainon chirped out, sounding much too excited and happy - and Mydei found himself baffled over how close that alpha was standing now. Able to feel Phainon’s chest pressed against his arm all while Mydei had to tilt his head over that.

“About what? We’re at a funeral, Phainon.” Mydei reminded him, eyes moving to the way Cifera seemed on edge - antsy almost as her eyes danced between the two men worryingly.

And Mydei couldn’t blame him at all, not when Phainon smelled as if he wanted to strangle someone still. Much too strong and overbearing, painful to the nose almost with how choking it was.

Mydei felt himself swallow over the way those hands on his shoulders tightened; “I.. I just miss hanging out, you know!”

Phainon looked upset - as if he was doing his best to hold it together right now but that only gave Mydei more and more questions. 

“Phainon, I already tried t-”

“Wow, wow.. Very quick on your feet to find my prince, aren’t you? I’ve barely been able to speak to him all this funeral alone..” Cifera cut in, obviously aware of the way Mydei was feeling uncomfortable now - doing her best to save him from those hands digging into his shoulders.

Only, Phainon’s smile immediately vanished over that - jaw looking clenched and crooked as he tilted his own head to the side leisurely, “.. Your prince?”

Cifera only nodded as she moved a hand to Mydei’s own wrist, taking it gently with a small nervous laugh escaping her throat, “Yes’m. This prince is coming along with m-”

Only Cifera’s words were cut off with a sharp yelp from her lips - one that rang in Mydei’s ears as the alpha’s familiar hand immediately let go of his own arm over the death grip Phainon now had her wrist in. Tight, horribly tight - even Mydei could see that from his perspective as she tried to pull away from him.

Futile as Phainon only kept her locked in that hold, blue eyes looking like they were almost in a daze - unfocused as he stared as Cifera - unmoving and unblinking. All before his hand seemed to tighten if the little noise from Cifera’s throat was any indicator of it - making Mydei grab Phainon’s own wrist as well. 

“Don’t grab her like that.” Mydei hissed out, a little glad that those blank icy eyes darted to him - all before blinking and subsequently releasing the fellow alpha. 

All before Phainon nervously chuckled - his own free hand moving to rub at the nape of his neck idly. 

“Sorry! Haha, sorry.” Phainon mumbled nervously, but Mydei found himself only narrowing his eyes over that - doing his best to understand what was wrong with this man today, “I just ah..” 

“She is my friend, Phainon.” Mydei growled, releasing his hold on Phainon’s wrist to instead scowl at him heavily - wondering why on earth this alpha was acting like this. 

Yet, that warning and hissed out words only made Phainon pause, blinking widely like an owl at Mydei for a few moments. All before chuckling oddly, cold and hollow in his tone, “.. I’m your friend too, aren’t I, Mydei?”

Of course he was.

But all Mydei could do was glare at the man, doing his best to scowl at that alpha that clearly had stepped over a line here; “Not if you hurt Cifera like that again, Phainon.”

“I.. I understand, I’m sorry.” Phainon immediately nodded, sounding more like a kicked dog than a man who actually understood why he was being scolded, “Mydei, I-”

“I have to go now. See you around, later maybe.” Mydei interrupted, feeling a bit distant in this topic now as he was supposed to be here mourning the person he was going to spend the rest of his life with. Only for them to be killed at such a young age, and for what?

Mydei didn’t know.

And instead of mourning, he was just being hounded by a needy alpha who didn’t seem to even know what they wanted anymore.

“.. Maybe?” Phainon choked out, sounding horribly lost over that flippant usage of a word - as if it had been a stab wound directly into his soul, “Mydei, don’t leave me.”

Mydei gave an exasperated sigh as he looked at that man, squinting a little before tiredly speaking, “Phainon I-”

But Phainon spoke quicker over that, “Aren’t we still friends? Do you not feel any bond with me anymore?”

Mydei felt his breath freeze in his lungs over the panicked nature of Phainon’s words, so rushed and emotional that Mydei’s mind was spinning as he tried to understand the alpha’s souring scent. Turbulent and fluctuating so much like he couldn’t pick a mood to settle on. 

The clearest thing was not in his scent however, but in those broken and hurt words - sounding like a scolded child as he stared at Mydei. Begging for a response.

And Mydei could only try his best to swallow down his urge to comfort that alpha, to make his scent sweeter to try to calm him down and rub his scent glands on him, purring and doing his best to soothe the alpha.. But those were all things he couldn’t do to a prince who wasn’t his in public. 

Or alone, really, considering Phainon didn’t want his scent on him anyway.

Instead, he only balled his fist - shaking his head slowly as he fought his instincts back, “Of course I do, Phainon.. What is this line of questioning about?”

Phainon seemed to equally freeze up over that - eyes going round and as wide as an owl’s all before he took a slow step back. Looking so very nervous before he moved to place a hand over his own chest, bowing deeply, “.. Nothing. I’m sorry, that was unbecoming of me. I wish you well, Prince Mydeimos.”

Mydei found himself stunned over that - unable to look away from that prince who remained in that bow. Eyes closed and looked so painfully stressed, smelling of it as well to where Mydei.. Found himself endlessly confused. 

“You.. Too, Prince Phainon..” Mydei eventually mumbled out, feeling the way Cifera was still tugging at his arm - but Mydei felt almost hollow and porcelain as he stared at that frozen Phainon. It was like he was refusing to look at Mydei, ashamed of his own actions finally and trying to repent.

And all Mydei could do was leave him there and turn to allow Cifera to drag him away, only as she instantly began hissing a whisper to Mydei as they left the funeral area swiftly. 

“That was beyond bizarre.” Cifera huffed, making Mydei blink as they moved to a more open area - his eyes moving to look where they had just left instead of at Cifera. Trying to understand what he had done to earn that ire today. So vibrant and fierce, angry and snapping as Phainon seemed more annoyed than ever towards him.

Not to mention the way he had gripped Cifera so cruelly, a thing Mydei couldn’t remember him doing before.. 

Mydei had to move his hands to run through his hair - sighing so painfully loudly as he tried to come to terms with whatever was happening; “He seemed.. Angry at me?”

“I don’t know if that’s the right word, really.. He seemed more like..” Cifera quickly countered, only to trail off as she seemed to struggle to voice her thoughts - looking almost nervous; “Uh..”

But that only made Mydei more curious, more eager to learn what the hell someone else was viewing this situation as; “Seemed like what?”

Cifera slowly waved her hand from side to side, looking like she was about to start sweating at any moment before she cleared her throat and met Mydei’s eyes dead on. "Possessive. Jealous, even. Like he was going to rip my hand off if I touched you again, really..” Cifera moved a hand to tap her lips with the memories, “He was putting out some heavy pheromones, but they were all uh..”

Mydei only raised a brow at her - a clear enough signal to continue apparently as she sighed dramatically and put her own hands to her temples. Massaging them for a brief moment before lowering her hands once again.

“Threatening, really..” Cifera explained, lacing her fingers together in a fiddling type of fashion as her eyes seemed to dance around actually looking at Mydei for this conversation;  “Like an alpha whose mate is being threatened right in front of them..”

Mydei felt his eyes twitch over that, tilting his head to one side as he tried to understand that; “Jealous of my deceased mate?”

“No.. I think he thinks I’m stealing his spot in your life as your best friend, maybe?” Cifera spoke with a loud sigh, unthreading her fingers and shrugging dramatically - all while shaking her head quickly. 

Actions that made Mydei stare at her and try to process those words.

Wasn’t he the one that had been shut out Phainon’s life in the first place? The alpha hadn’t seemed very keen on meeting Mydei after that letter asking for marriage..

Mydei had to huff over it all, “.. Weird, I didn’t think he would care about such a thing.” 

“Well.. I guess even if he doesn’t want to be your mate, he at the very least cares about you deeply.” Cifera shrugged out - but something still seemed off about it all. Like she wasn’t quite sure of her own words regarding the topic.

Or was just stumbling over something Mydei himself was currently missing - he didn’t know. 

“That’s reassuring in a way.” Mydei mumbled, but he wasn’t truly sure if it was considering how off balanced he felt about it all.

Thrown for a loop while pondering what the hell Phainon’s angle currently was.. 

Cifera seemed less than convinced about that however, instead coughing a little to clear her throat before watching a hand idly, “Is it..? He seemed kind of.. You know.. Unwell?” 

“Did he?” Mydei asked while feigning innocence, because he certainly knew that - he just couldn’t understand why that was.

Was it over Mydei’s own actions, or Cifera being close to him and seemingly replacing Phainon?

Cifera only raised a brow over that, clearly not buying his own confusion either; “Mydei.. You yourself had to scold him, you know as well as I do that he was acting way too aggressive over you.”

“Mm..” Mydei hummed, having to give a slow roll of his shoulders, “I kind of like that though.”

He wasn’t lying.

Something about Phainon being possessive about Mydei when he was touched by Cifera was something he had always longed and yearned for from that alpha. 

.. He probably was a little embarrassing in hindsight, but he couldn’t help his secondary gender’s instincts that desired that alpha.

“Dude.” Cifera replied, making Mydei immediately shake his head quickly - face burning over the words he had actually uttered all before moving hands above his chest. 

“Well, not him being mean to you, no. I mean just..” Mydei trailed off, trying to do his best to process his own feelings and explain them to Cifera. But even he knew he was being insane here.

There was no way Phainon was in the right considering the way he had grabbed Cifera so harshly.

“I know, I get it, kind of. Mr. Omega likes his alpha that he wants to mate with him growling over him, whatever.”

“.. Yes.”

“Your instincts are going to get me mauled by that white haired growling man.” Cifera teased, her voice light and gentle in a way that made Mydei sigh over how kind she truly was beneath it all. Even if she had threatened to neuter him a few times when he would lust for Phainon in the past..

Mydei had to move a hand up to his nose and rub the bridge of it, breathing out a shaky exhale, “I’m sorry.”

“It’s fine.. It’s fine..” Cifera told him, sounding earnest enough, all before continuing her thoughts,  “I really do think you should just ask him why he rejected you.”

Mydei couldn’t.

He had thought about it so much, languished alone and cried over that man embarrassingly, he couldn’t bring himself to ask why his closest friend had rejected him. Not when all their years together were spent with silly tender promises of being together forever, silly moments of Phainon swearing his blade to Mydei for the rest of his life while on one knee, silly memories of Mydei trusting all of those words fully..

.. All too silly to think about. 

Mydei already knew the answer, anyway: “There’s nothing to ask about. He prefers alphas, I’m an omega. That’s how it worked out to be, nothing more, nothing less.”

“But he didn’t.. Act like it was nothing when I was around you.” Cifera countered without missing a single heart beat of a second - raising a brow inquisitively that made Mydei bite into his tongue a little. 

“You didn’t see how he acted towards me around that alpha either. He despised the fact I even touched her blatantly.” Mydei fired right back, doing his best to keep his voice leveled over how much this topic was still agony for him. 

.. He just wanted someone to bite his neck and force him to move on, force a bond onto him so he could be required to no longer desire that man. Anything but the crippling and haunting thoughts of those sunny smiles that made his day brighter no longer being his to see anymore. Only ever receiving cold and calculated stares, all before Phainon’s scent turned sour and bitter over being around Mydei.

All because he had become an omega that Phainon didn’t want. The wrong secondary gender that made Phainon look away from him and forget all their time together, even if he claimed to still want to have some odd bond together.

“I guess so.. But it’s worrying..”

Mydei found himself tensing up over that, slowly tilting his head. He could understand how it was worrying, honestly, considering how he had acted towards Cifera and grabbed her. But regardless, Mydei still wanted to know her thoughts deeper. 

Thus he probed.. “Why is it worrying?” 

“He’s scary, I don’t mean to insult your oldest friend, but..” Cifera moved a little, pacing as she crossed her arms - clearly trying to figure out how to say this without hurting Mydei’s feelings on the topic. But if anything..

His feelings were simply confused.

Lost and unknowing why that alpha was so angry or jealous, when Mydei had already tried to be close again and was turned down months ago in that marriage rejection. He had spent nights pouring his heart and soul into that letter, only to get a scripted rejection in reply that made him fully realize how idiotic he had truly been to not even earn a specialized response from Phainon himself.

No earnest mutual feelings of love like they were children, no promises, just an alpha who had moved on to chasing the things he actually could grow to love. 

And Mydei almost doubted he read that letter, instead sighing over how his omega friend was vying for his attention and affection, when all Phainon wanted was an alpha.

.. He truly did have the worst luck in regards to his secondary gender, didn’t he?

Cifera only continued however, unaware of Mydei’s horrible and derailing thoughts on the matter at hand; “There’s something in his eyes, something that looked at me for the briefest moment like he was going to hunt me down for sport until you told him not to.” 

Cifera paused, her vivid eyes moving to focus on Mydei’s own - making him realize how tired he must look when a look of worry flashed over her features. Probably due to his own desires being denied every time he met that alpha, biting down urges to dote and soothe him, and instead walking away repeatedly.

He felt so useless, but what was he supposed to do when Phainon had already started to move on? He couldn’t cross those boundaries, he could only sit on the other side of them and wait to see Phainon’s own wedding invitation at his door when he won his desired alpha’s hand. 

“I just fear.. He’s already mentally snapped over something, you know?”

chapters.title: Chapter 3
chapters.html:
Mydei could admit many things about himself.

One, he did in fact prefer sweets over sour or bitter food - and he refused to say or agree it was a bad thing when he also took care of his well-maintained diet.

Two, he absolutely had always enjoyed learning self-defense more than anything else when he was a child, next to his cooking classes. 

Third, he had never been good at meeting and bonding with new people no matter how much he tried - it always felt so painfully awkward.

And that last thing was one of the worst things to struggle with as a crown prince of a kingdom, especially now as he awkwardly sat there with a drink in hand watching the room move about. 

Rapid courting.

He was actually having to partake in a royal rapid courting session - giving out warm smiles and praying that it was enough as people passed him by. 

It wasn’t hard to see why, considering he smelled almost just like an alpha - the only people that had been actually approaching him all night were confused omegas. Rubbing on him and trying to admire his body, touching his arms as they saw fit - and Mydei really had to rub his temples over that as he wondered how the hell alphas put up with handsy omegas.

“Mydeimos.” His name being said was enough to make him stiffen easily, blinking his eyes to continue watching the chatty laughter and sounds of the room. All while slowly turning to look at the man he already knew would be beaming a smile at him. So bright and welcoming, beautiful, really, especially as Phainon had slicked the side of his hair down.

Leaving his fluffy bangs in his face, but the rest free - making him even more attractive effortlessly, and doing nothing decent to help against the slight agony Mydei felt as he felt a level of lust towards that man hit him. Gorgeous and tempting, and not his at all.

“.. Phainon?” Mydei asked as he blinked at that man - blinking over how he could swear he saw him almost perk up over his name being said and attention given to him. But Mydei chose to write that off as anything else as his eyes slipped away from that alpha again.

Mainly for his own sanity as he heard his heart beat so loudly in his own ears - deafening him as he tried to not think about the way Phainon looked stunning in pure white. Waist cinched nicely, leaving nothing to anyone’s imagination at the least - and that smile on his lips read as if it were a dare for someone to touch him.

Like Phainon was wanting it, but Mydei had to huff over it - remembering how his day had been with omegas rubbing on him and assuming he was an alpha for them to seduce.

Phainon didn’t seem aware of that at all as he took a light and bouncy step forward: “Fancy seeing you here.” Cutting the distance all while happily speaking, making Mydei’s eyes focus on him again instead of the people who were absolutely having much more fun than he currently was.

“Is it? Aren’t all the eligible nobles and the sort here?” Mydei retorted easily, not giving the question too much thought in favor of trying to ignore Phainon. Praying that if he gave lackluster replies, the alpha would leave him be.

Even if there wasn’t what Mydei really wanted deep down, but how else was he supposed to move on otherwise?

“Mm..” Phainon hummed over the question, evidently not caring that Mydei was speaking as flat as ever and doing his best to give Phainon little attention. That didn’t seem to matter at all, especially as Phainon leaned into him a tad, bumping their shoulders together in a friendly and teasing motion, “Has anyone caught your eye today?”

But that was enough to make Mydei stiffen a little, eyes moving to focus on that sweet alpha’s face as he tried to understand why this man was acting so friendly towards him right now. Small talk, probably, but Mydei’s heart wished it was something else. Regardless, Mydei sighed over the question; “An alpha named Aulus.”

Parmenides had been an unfortunate tragedy, but it wasn’t as if Mydei knew that man to begin with - he was clueless towards the man’s true personality and if they would actually get along in their free time.

.. So as horrible as it was to say, there wasn’t much to ‘move on’ from there, considering at the end of the day.. They had been complete strangers.

That much was made obvious to Mydei as his eyes swept back to the people dancing and having fun in front of him - eyes studying the way they danced around and chatted in their own little circles of the party.

“.. Aulus?” Phainon quoted in a tone of voice that sounded high-strung, so stressed out that Mydei couldn’t really understand the strain in his voice. Instead only tilting his head to the side as he stared at that man - trying his best to understand what Phainon was thinking.

Alas, those blue eyes gave nothing away as he continued to look little distantly at the people conversing now. Icy blue eyes seemed unfocused as he pursed his lips the slightest bit over the sight. 

And all Mydei could do was attempt to ignore it, shaking his head in a slow fashion before shrugging his shoulders a bit lazily;  “An older prince, but he talked to me about cooking and bonded with me over that.”

‘Older’ was not a lie at all, if anything, he had to assume that prince was too old to even mate anymore - probably some political trophy if his kingdom had never allowed him to mate even at his age.. Showing off their unmated prince was them mocking their enemies, flaunting how unstressed they were.

.. At least, that’s what Mydei had to assume when he could barely smell the alpha’s scent when he had spoken to Mydei. Unlike Phainon who always seemed drenched and trying to show off for everyone every time Mydei was around him..

“Ah..” Phainon eventually said, eyes moving away from the crowd and back to Mydei - settling on him with a raised brow, “Do you prefer older men?”

Those words were said like a joke, a simple little jest between friends but for some reason there was something beneath them. A venom like being burnt, branding into Mydei’s skin and leaving a horrible gash as Phainon said them. And Phainon also looked almost uncomfortable over his own words, jaw quirking to the side slightly to give the illusion that he was biting into his own cheeks angrily. Gritting his teeth, maybe.

Mydei had to stare at that, all before leisurely shaking his head - forcing himself to laugh a little freely over the question being presented to him, “.. I don’t care about them being older than me.”

“Oh..” Phainon immediately hummed out, all while still sounding a little unconvinced of such a fact. And Mydei had to huff over that - just a quiet exhale as he tried to riddle what was wrong  with his man today.

“What about you? Anyone catching your own eye?” Mydei asked, all while preparing himself mentally for whatever answers he may receive in reply to that. His mind was already wandering back to that golden haired woman without a single thought being spared as he swept his gaze over the people still conversing.

Anything, but look at Phainon as his heart was broken repeatedly, yet.. He was the one asking, wasn’t he? This cycle of self-inflicted misery was doomed to loop again and again if he kept asking questions like this one. 

“Someone already has my eye.” Phainon answered in an almost dazed and dreamy sounding voice.

One that Mydei didn’t even dare look at him over - feeling one of his eyes twitch over it regardless.

“Lovely.” Was Mydei’s flat and bored reply, trying his best to sound enthused but he knew himself best - there was no way he could sell such a lie when he had been writhing over this man for months, “Then what’s the point of coming here?” 

Phainon didn’t answer at first - only letting the daunting silence linger all before Mydei found it in himself to look at Phainon blankly. Staring at the way those piercing blue eyes were settled onto him in such an unblinking manner - focusing wholly on him; “.. To watch.”

To watch.

Mydei flicked his eyes back to the crowd - ignoring the way that man seemed more than a little perplexed by Mydei rather than anyone else here. But he couldn’t find it in himself to comment on such a thing either.

“Uh huh..” Mydei agreed slowly, watching the sway of people dancing idly with their new found interests alongside those who merely seemed to simply be chatting between each other. Doing their best to meet and fall in love in the short amount of time allotted. 

.. Mydei was supposed to be doing the same as well, wasn’t he? And yet, he stood beside the alpha who was no longer his to stand next to, if anything, he was probably seen as a hindrance to that alpha now. An annoyance of an omega who was warding off anyone who may have the wrong idea about them being in love.

Yet, Mydei didn’t move.

“Hehe.. I mean it! People watching is seriously interesting, and I need to watch the person I’m interested in like a hawk!” Phainon chirped out, making Mydei move his golden eyes back to that man - raising a brow over that. 

“Do you?” Mydei asked earnestly, because that alpha he had met before did not seem at all like she needed any protection. He was actually almost positive she would be insulted for him to assume such of her, but it’s not like it was Mydei’s place to say, was it?

“What if they try to replace me? I’ll feel so heart broken.. Of course I have to watch them!”

.. Mydei darted his eyes away at that, not longer wanting to look at the man that had already done that to himself. Already replaced him and let him suffer his broken heart alone agonizingly - already abandoned him and hadn’t even brought it up once.

And that was precisely why Mydei couldn’t bring it up either, not when he thought about the fact he was worth so little he hadn’t even gotten a reply. No acknowledgement at all, it was all too much for him to try to consider as he instead.. Didn’t.

He would simply move on, and that's all he could possibly do. 

“You’re such an odd man..” Mydei instead forced himself to grumble out, not even finding it in himself to look at him. Instead biting down his own feelings, again and again as he tried to not think about reality as it kept seeping into his skin. 

“How so?” Phainon asked, voice sounding so very innocent as he asked that question.

Mydei could only sigh over it - doing his best to remain looking at anything but that man at his side; “An alpha can defend themself.”

Phainon was quiet over that for a few moments, all before bubbling out a shy or timid sounding laugh - one that was almost unlike Phainon as it ran against Mydei’s ears. Scratchy and itchy, not at all fitting the man he knew to be ‘Phainon’ at all.

“That’s true.. I don’t doubt at all that they can fight their own battles, but that doesn’t mean I don’t want to make sure they’re not replacing me.” Phainon pointed out, and that was the first time that Mydei couldn’t stop himself from giving Phainon an odd and pointed look. All before tilting his head to the side as he tried to understand why that man was feeling almost.. Self conscious? 

“How can you have such confidence issues when you are the Prince of Okhema?” Mydei genuinely was asking, moving to cross his arms over his chest as he peered at that alpha - blinking over the way Phainon’s smile faltered just a little.

Just the tiniest of bits as he stared right into Mydei’s eyes, all before laughing all the same and shaking his head slowly. 

“Mm..” Phainon purred out, sounding no less amused or perhaps growing more fascinated by the conversation, “I wonder.. But! Never fear! I will still smile and be as charming for you as you desire, Mydei!”

Mydei could only look away over those words.

“.. How kind of you.” Mydei mumbled after a few moments, finding himself chewing on his lip - probably hard enough to cause himself to bleed as he found that woman now locking eyes and approaching him with a rather pleased look on her face. 

One that Mydei could only assume was over finding Phainon, after all.. She was beautiful. Dressed up to tooth and nail, flowers in her hair and looking so beautiful in every meaning of the word. 

“Ah! Aglaea!?” Phainon chirped out, his voice coming out sweeter and more controlled now that she was around - obviously stiffening up and immediately on his best behavior for the woman who was smoothly walking towards the both of them. 

And that made Mydei tilt his head, not due to the way Phainon was acting, no. But because her eyes were not leaving Mydei’s own, not looking or blinking as she gave a polite smile. Nothing more than a smile as a means to an end as she seemed to try to force Mydei into a sense of comfort. 

Not like that would work, considering Mydei was more than merely a little used to awkward situations of meeting people like this. Especially as she seemed much too calculated and aware - as if she had a goal in mind and Mydei had little to no idea over what that may be as she didn’t even look at Phainon at all. 

“Prince Mydeimos.” She instead greeted with a small nod of her head oddly, making Mydei blink uncomfortably over it.

He had been taught to be polite always, but as of right now - he felt awkward beyond repair as he sniffed at her deep aroma a bit shyly. Trying to get a read on her mood, and coming up empty handed bizarrely, making him be forced back into square one. Unsure and unknowing of her goal. 

“.. Lady Aglaea.” Mydei nodded right back, feeling as if he should try to slip away and allow them some peace of mind. But that clearly wasn’t going to happen as Aglaea’s eyes never strayed from him, staring at him all before her feet paused.

A hand extended, “May I have a dance?”

Mydei wasn’t sure what to think over that - mind going blank as his eyes trailed down to that gentle looking hand. Small, her hand was so very small in comparison of his own - looking almost delicate, as if she had such deft and skilled fingers for work that needed extreme detailing.

Was that what Phainon preferred..? 

Someone that was elegant and graceful, polite and collected.. All things that Mydei wasn’t quite sure had been matching up with his own disarrayed personality in the past few months of agonizing over himself.

“Uh..” Mydei mumbled out, voice lower than a whisper as  he blinked to Phainon - doing his best to see what that man was currently thinking over Mydei being stolen away by his desired mates.

Only Phainon quickly waved his hands over his chest - much too innocently as he shook his head, trying to feign some odd emotion Mydei couldn’t get a read on as he tilted his head over that reaction. 

“It’s fine! Don’t worry about me!” Phainon told him, sounding convincing - sure. But.. Mydei didn’t know how much he knew about the man anymore, considering his friendship with him throughout the years already felt like an odd lie he had been sold and had completely accepted.

Mydei was probably the foolish one here, one way or another. Especially given the fact he had already been rejected by the man who promised him all his love, the same man that made Mydei braid his hair in the morning still with a numb sense of hope.

An aching hope that dwindled every single day.

But this party wasn’t really the time to dwell on such things, instead giving his own hand to Aglaea numbly; “Alright..”

Aglaea didn’t waste a single moment, instead taking up Mydei’s hand with a gentle squeeze - all to quickly lead him away. Away from Phainon in specific, it seemed, “We’ve never quite talked before, I thought this would be a proper and lovely time to speak to you in private.”

Mydei couldn’t imagine what she would want to discuss with him - barely able to hold in his scoff as his feet moved on their own, following after her in almost an utmost daze before choosing to quote that; “.. In private.”

“Without Phainon.” She pointed out, and that made Mydei blink over why she would want to escape speaking around him.

But maybe she just wanted his blessing for falling in love with his best friend, he couldn’t find it in himself to want to give such a thing. But he would lie anyway and agree if he must. 

“Right.” Mydei grumbled, not thinking much as she immediately took the lead in this dance - something he didn’t find himself fighting against as she seemed more than a little pleased to do. 

“You two have been friends almost your entire life, correct?” Aglaea asked almost instantaneously, making Mydei blink slightly downwards at her - peering at the shorter woman as she still seemed more than just a little amused.

Something about that made Mydei feel like he was a fly caught in a spider’s web, silk already making the efforts to strangle him and drink him dry. All while elegantly moving in a rather lazy circular motion together, obviously neither cared about the actual dance - more keen on their discussion apparently.

“Yes.” Mydei agreed, barely even really registering the question because how else would he reply? Of course they were, and Phainon had probably told her that as well - so why ask Mydei like she didn’t believe Phainon?

Or was this some type of set up that he didn’t quite understand?

Aglaea hummed over that answer, eyes seeming no less amused as their gazes met - if anything, she only seemed like she was forcing him in to check in this game of chess they were playing confusingly, “Has he confessed to you who he is seeking as his mate? This topic has been quite perplexing to me.”

Ah.

She wanted to hear the latest gossip on who Phainon was in love with currently - and as his eyes met with hers, he couldn’t even feign a lie either way. He knew nothing on this topic for a fact, all he had was minor clues and well.. They all lead back to this alpha in specific; “.. No.”

“Is that so? He says they’re an alpha.” Aglaea sighed out, seeming like that was not at all the answer she had been wanting as she shook her head - still swaying both of them easily to the distant music that was so mindnumbing Mydei had long since zoned it out.

If Mydei wasn’t gritting his teeth yet, he certainly was now as he furrowed his brows over those words; “.. Yes, I’m aware of that.”

He probably was a poor actor when it came to acting like he was excited about speaking on Phainon’s love life - but he couldn’t help it. How could he ever act and feign his joy when the man he had entrusted his heart to openly did not want him..?

It was a tough thing to bite down, especially since he had to for the sake of their kingdoms in the long run as well. Acting like he was fine and happy and that the prince who will be king one day just like Mydei hadn’t shattered a piece of him that he knew he would never get back wasn’t exactly an easy task. 

Only, a hand tightening on Mydei’s own was enough to ground him back to reality - making him blink as the woman who had a rather devious expression on her face. Tame, controlled, but under all those layers of calculation was one that no one could fully mask when plotting things.

The joy of things going well was seeping through her features slightly; “Speaking of alphas, may I overstep my boundaries for a mere moment?”

“Go ahead.” Mydei nodded, not exactly sure what she could possibly be wanting to ask him - though he could only imagine it was about Phainon’s preferences. 

“Your scent is quite rich and dark, heavy even.. But there’s something I can’t put my finger on under it all.. Are you a beta?”

.. Beta?

Mydei found himself resisting the urge to tilt his head over that, trying his best not to find it odd that she was asking this  about Mydei. Had Phainon kept his secondary gender from her for some reason..?

.. Was he that ashamed of Mydei?

It didn’t sound like something Phainon would overly care about, but apparently he cared more about secondary genders than Mydei had originally thought anyway.. 

Mydei found himself pursing his lips over that, frowning a little bit over the way that frustrated him endlessly. He didn’t have a choice in the matter, so the idea of Phainon refusing to tell people..

Mydei could only feel a little satisfied as he said one simple word; “No.”

“No?” Aglaea repeated, sounding very surprised by that as she blinked slightly widened eyes - and Mydei had a lingering thought that she probably wasn’t caught off guard very often. That opinion was only enhanced by how she seemed more and more eager for Mydei to continue with her prolonged silence after.

Making Mydei only press out a sigh, “I’m an omega.” He admitted. Barely an admittance, he had assumed most people were aware the crown prince of Kremnos was an omega - but he supposed it wasn’t that odd if the alphas who only loved other alphas didn’t keep up with someone like him.

Just another nobody that they were not interested in loving, even if Aglaea seemed to be more than a little shocked by it. Obviously, Mydei had never even been on her radar at all - let alone for love before hearing Phainon was his childhood friend.

Then, just like others for many other things, he was a stepping stone for her to use easily in her mind, most likely.

Only, she seemed to take a moment to hum over that confession, “.. Interesting. Are you wearing scent blockers?”

Odd.

This was such an odd situation and line of conversation that he found himself quirking his jaw a little, clenching it just a tad as he realized he had no idea what she wanted from him. Not the slightest hint in this regard, unless..

She was assuming he was the alpha Phainon is in love with? 

Humorous, considering he’s not an alpha, and had already been rejected. If anything, he was probably the furthest one in the list of love for Phainon to even consider as an option.

“Of course.” Mydei told her flatly, unsure of what else he could ever possibly say - lying was pointless, but he had no idea what she was aiming at either..

“Medicated?”

Mydei had once assumed her to be proper and very polite, but now he found his mind reeling as she almost overstepped her boundaries.

.. Or she just knew Phainon’s oldest friend wouldn't hurt his lover, no matter how royal Mydei may be.

“Of course.” Mydei repeated, though a bit more stiff as she forced them both to leisurely walk in a circle - her eyes never once leaving him as she continued this odd interrogation. 

“Hmm.. Fascinating..” Aglaea hummed out, seeming like he had given her much to think about.

But Mydei could only grit his teeth a little over that, “I hold no shame towards my secondary gender, I am merely aware that my scent is not everyone’s cup of tea.”

Aglaea nodded over that, as if she could possibly understand all before making a quiet little noise. One that was almost completely drowned out by the other people around the duo, making Mydei blink over this woman’s cleverness that seemed to keep looping back to the main topic; “Does Phainon know?”

“Of course.” Mydei repeated for a third time - sighing a bit as Aglaea swayed him to the side yet again, clearly taking the lead in this dance now. But it’s not like Mydei had even tried to combat that - feeling his own mind lagging behind as he moved to the rhythm with her.

He had always hated dancing.

It felt so stiff and agonizing, he much rather preferred sparring and enjoying the fluid movements along with the adrenaline surging through his veins and making him feel wild. 

All dancing did was make him feel muzzled, constricted and trapped with his partner - especially now that he never had a chance to dance with the man that had once made learning these dances fun. No longer laughing and stepping on each other’s toes as they were more invested in the other’s words. Now mundane and boring as he was always forced to give replies to questions like these.

Aglaea made a humming noise at that, seeming almost just a bit amused by those words: “Oh.. I almost assumed he didn’t.”

“He does.” Mydei stated again, because how could Phainon possibly not know? He had confessed many things in his letter to Phainon; it wasn’t very hard to gather from context clues that he meant mating bonds and that ‘sharing his heat with him’ probably entailed Mydei being an omega.

Aglaea heaved out a heavy exhale over that, shaking her head slowly as if Mydei was the only answer she had conjured up as a love interest for Phainon and not herself, “Back to square one I believe then. Thank you for your time, Prince Mydeimos.”

“.. Thank you for the dance.” Mydei replied, not even blinking as he bowed towards her - copying her polite curtsy before she immediately walked away. Leaving him there baffled in his own thoughts - struggling to understand what exactly was the point of all of that in the long run. 

Probably just to look for answers he couldn’t offer, solve her own jealousy towards the mate she wanted by assuming it was Mydei.

.. It wasn’t. It never had been, that alpha she rejoined speaking with so smoothly - white haired and beaming at her like a puppy, had never truly been Mydei’s, no matter how much he wished he was and had deluded himself into thinking he was.

“Prince Mydeimos, you’re exactly who I was looking for!” A different voice called to him, one that he wasn’t quite used to yet that made Mydei turn just a bit - blinking at the deep voice man who gave him a toothy grin. 

“Aulus.. Hello there.” Mydei greeted formally, feeling the anxious nervousness dig into his gut and bury itself there - itching and clawing deeper and deeper as he tried to give a good and decent smile back. Trying his best to be friendly towards anyone who spoke to him tonight.

.. Besides, he had no reason not to be kind to this man.

“You told me you would tell me your pie recipe, so I found myself quite eager and retrieved some parchment to write it down. You don’t mind talking right now, do you?” Aulus asked innocently, making Mydei huff over how that smile on his own face was becoming less forced over being coaxed to speak about cooking.

Mydei found himself still a little stunned over the question at the least, eyes moving upwards to look at that alpha who now was talking to Aglaea again. Icy blue eyes twinkled as he spoke to that golden woman, seeming wholly so very interested in their topic. Much more interested in her words than whatever Mydei had talked to him with recently, and Mydei felt it yet again.

The knowledge that he needed to let go, to stop yearning for someone who didn’t want him.

And Mydei could only move his eyes back to the salt and pepper haired man - hairs graying, but Mydei found himself to not mind that. After all, he was rather fond of white hair anyway.. And that man seemed more eager to speak to him than anyone else had been in such a long time.

An alpha earnestly desiring his attention, and Mydei found no reason not to give all of it to him. 

To the only alpha that seemed to actually want his attention, anyway.

“I would love to.”

──────────────

“You haven’t spoken much this afternoon, are you alright, Phainon?”

Phainon lulled his head to the side, legs still crossed as he sat there on the floor - mindlessly sitting there as Cyrene had been the one to focus on her actual work. Not to say he wouldn’t have helped if she wanted any help, but she certainly had growled a little at him over how he kept spilling ink drops when he zoned out.

Thus, he was merely sitting in her office with her for comfort, eyes moving around the room in a daze. Never focusing on one thing for more than a few seconds before moving to the next and trying to take it all in. As if he hadn’t been in this room a hundred times before, and wouldn’t be in here a hundred times after.

“Just.. Thinking about the type of person I am.” Phainon told him in a dull tone - not even convincing himself of being well with how dejected his voice sounded to his ears. 

“The type of person you are?” Cyrene echoed out, sounding wholly unconvinced or perhaps a little baffled by his own self questioning - her own eyes looking confused as he blinked at her. Eyebrows raising to her own hairline as she seemed to ponder those words.

Only a little before Phainon spoke again, voice quieter as he sat there - swaying himself from side to side as he grabbed his own legs, “Do you think my personality is okay?”

Cyrene completely paused her movements now, no longer writing in her book or answering letters - instead giving him her full attention, “.. Phainon, what kind of question is that? I’m your sister.. I think I should have picked on you more while growing up, honestly.”

Phainon barked out a quiet laugh at that - all before pressing out a heavy exhale as the sting of the world settled back uncomfortably into his bones, “Mean.. I just meant that I’ve been thinking about, well.. Myself a lot lately. Was I more appealing as a kid?”

Cyrene moved to settle her quill down, giving Phainon the feeling that he had made an error somewhere as he swallowed roughly. He wanted to be comforted, sure, but he just.. He didn’t know how to feel comforted at all when the person he desired to comfort him was slipping away more and more. 

“Again, I’m your sister. What do you mean by appealing?” Cyrene asked, sounding no less like she was a little offended by the line of questioning. As if she couldn’t understand Phainon’s new and rather random self hatred he seemed to be undergoing now. 

Phainon had to wave a hand dismissively over that, trying his best to seem more relaxed for her sake of this topic, “Like.. Friendly? Someone you would want to be friends with?”

“Alright. Let me put myself in the shoes of someone who did not have to live with you growing up.” Cyrene mumbled, all before moving her hands to her head - slowly rubbing her temples in a massaging fashion.

Only..

She didn’t speak after that - eyes closed as she kept both hands on opposite sides of her head, slowly rubbing at her head. And Phainon found himself tilting his head to the side over that. Just to stare and wait.. And wait.. And for some reason wait - all before his patience snapped. 

“Well?” Phainon pressed, feeling himself biting his tongue as he waited for Cyrene’s opinion on it all and to change her mindset or whatever. 

Cyrene sighed over that, not giving up yet on the whole ‘closing my eyes and thinking deeply on this’ thing she was doing; “This takes time.. There’s a lot of memories I’m having to try to forget about..” Phainon scoffed over those words, only to immediately stand up and make a move to leave that office room - only Cyrene whined over that; “Wait wait, I’ll be serious, okay?”

Phainon paused - finding himself already standing up and staring at her expectantly with those words. Waiting for whatever her ‘serious’ advice could possibly be right now as he moved a hand to his hip, blinking at his sister who seemed to have an expression of pity on her face.

Probably because she could easily guess why he was rethinking himself and his stance in this world - mind endlessly looping back to that man with flaming hair and tattoos under his eyes and trailing his body. The most perfect alpha he had ever met, and he had to figure out how to compete for his hand..

“I think you’re perfectly fine, Phainon. There’s no reason why you should be thinking and considering such a thing when you’re such a bright ray of light to people.” Cyrene told him in a new voice - softer and kinder than the one from when she was being somewhat playful. Obviously aware her brother needed the soothing, just this once. 

“You’re gentle and kind to everyone, always making their days better, and I don’t think anyone has ever regretted seeing you walk towards them!”

Phainon had to take a moment to soak those words in, blinking over them all before giving a shy type of laugh. A nervous one that rubbed his throat uncomfortably - foreign and not meant for him as he thought about who may have regretted seeing him. He imagined there was at least one. 

Yet, he asked regardless of that; “.. Really?”

Cyrene nodded, her voice still sweet and kind - aiming to reassure him with every single word she uttered, “Of course.. You’re my brother.. The light of dawn, some would say in Okhema.. You’re a sweet hearted guy and you’ll find your way, I promise.”

Find his way.

Phainon repeated that over and over again in his head - rolling those words around in his mind dizzily as he walked his slow pace. Encroaching more and more in this foreign land that he didn’t know, ruining it just as he pleased and no one had stopped him.

Find his way.

Phainon instead found himself walking those empty halls - black gloves on the walls as he walked. Every foot step echoing painfully harsh against his ears, grating his nerves into dust as he chewed at his cheek’s gums. Numbly trying to find a grip on reality as he walked with such cold rigid movements.

His eyes could only follow his hand on the wall, perfect beige walls - well maintained with time and love throughout the years of this castle.

Now being left a mess as blood followed Phainon’s fingertips in their wake against it - only moving to ache his heart more as the crimson only reminded him of his beloved’s tattoos. Tattoos he was so fond of and had memorized the pattern of. Red that matched the tips of his dearest’s hair, beautiful and flowing as he had seen so many times as Mydei tied his hair into a braid as children.

Always murmuring something about ‘the braid means a promise was made to me.’ quietly as he did so. Always showing up with it in his hair, and quickly redoing it if it fell from their rough housing and wrestling.

And Phainon only wished he had asked what promise it was as he still saw it at the side of Mydei’s head every single day. 

“Why am I doing this..?” Phainon questioned with a barked out laugh tearing from his throat painfully, fingers twitching as he tried to dig his gloves into the wall a bit more roughly. 

Something was wrong with him.

There was no reason to question himself, not when after killing someone his clarity of mind was so strong that he knew he was in the wrong. 

And yet.

He had now gotten so jealous to where he killed not one, but two men for Mydei’s heart to be his own.

How old had Aulus been when he died?

He had been too feeble to even stand up straight when Phainon appeared in his bedroom doorway, too old to rouse himself easily and fight for his life, only seeming confused and scared. Phainon almost found pity in his heart towards that man, all before remembering the gentle and fond smile of Mydei while they spoke at that event.

Eyes seeming so fixed on Aulus, a genuine look of glee in his face - and none of it was towards Phainon, but at that man all while he walked with him and forgot he was turning his back on Phainon.

Why?

Was he really not good enough, to where even such an old man was better than Phainon? More acceptable? What should Phainon change about himself to be molded into an alpha Mydei would look at with such tenderness in his eyes like he used to?

His heart ached in a way he didn’t know possible - clenching and trembling against his ribcage as he even considered everything that had been going on.

Two. He had killed two people that were earning Mydei’s love faster than he was, worming into his heart so quickly and making Phainon gag and choke on his own venom as he tried to understand what he was doing wrong. 

His sweet Mydeimos was playing hard to get, without even meaning to, and Phainon just kept having to try to get around it. Doing his best to fight off the other competitors as he slowly chased down that man. Every step heavier than the last as he felt like he was chasing over Mydei’s back.

Cold and cunning, sharp and full of scorn for everyone that was barring his path. Lined with thorns that were pricking his hands as he tried to walk, but that was fine, wasn’t it? 

He was more than just a little willing to yearn and ache for Mydei, to cut his hands and dye his own flesh red with his blood and others if it meant they would be together. After all, he promised Mydei he would do that for him.

To love him and cherish him, to mate with him and be at his side. That hadn’t changed at all, not even a bit. The path had only become more warped, hadn’t it? More skewed and harder to traverse, but the man he had promised was still at the end of it.

He just had to straighten himself out, clean his hands from the blood of today, and continue walking to find his way to Mydeimos.

chapters.title: Chapter 4
chapters.html:
Phainon couldn’t help himself - whether it was instincts or pure desire to be around Mydei, he always found a way to his side. Gluing himself to that fiery haired man at every event he could out of sheer desperation as he moved to that Kremnoan’s side in pure habit.

Even at an event like this, his feet had easily carried him to that man as soon as he spotted him - much more beautiful than usual even. Mainly because he was clearly more relaxed in such a fast paced and friendly environment, no longer seeming on edge about who may approach him as he stood there with his back turned to Phainon.

Arms out on display as his shirt seemed to be lacking sleeves, most likely due to the warm weather befalling today, but Phainon only purred over it as he pressed a hand to Mydei’s back - an action that always made the crown prince jump nearly out of his skin.

“Hello there, Prince Mydeimos!” Phainon chirped out happily as he rounded the man, ignoring the way Mydei was glaring daggers into him in favor of taking in his apparel. 

Red tight shirt that left borderline nothing to the imagination with rather baggy black long pants - an interestingly normal outfit, but one that was beautiful on Mydei nonetheless. 

“Prince Phainon..” Mydei greeted, though he didn’t sound very excited as Phainon patted his back a little more warmly, trying to resist the urge to sniff at the alpha and make sure no one else had beat him here. But it was the same as ever, a muted deep and husky smell, smelling more like the oak and pine trees than before. Maybe a little edge of metal and rust that was so painfully Mydei.

“Don’t sound too excited to see me, now!” Phainon joked over that odd tone, not feeling the urge to let it eat away at him. Not yet, not as he beamed even more at Mydei - trying his best to make that prince feel comfortable in his company again as he stood there at his side. 

“Sorry, I just..” Mydei trailed off, eyes flicking away from Phainon and back to the petting zoo that was set up - and Phainon already was finding himself leaning into that alpha. Doing his best to scent him without being found out.. 

Phainon assuredly would have to take Mydei to that petting zoo later when the horde of children there were subsiding it, instead focusing on Mydei, “Mm? What’s the matter, Mydei?”

Mydei didn’t reply.

Not instantly, and not vocally - but his look of frustration and slight confusion written on his face was enough to tell Phainon that whatever it was.. It was eating away at him.

“I’ve just been having a stressful time as of late with a few affairs of my own. Nothing for you to fret over.” Mydei muttered out, shaking his head slowly as those golden eyes found their way back to Phainon.

Too keen.

Too meticulous.

As if he was trying to figure something out about Phainon, and Phainon didn’t know what that was. Well, he had a guess, but there was no reason for Mydei to have any guesses of ill intent Phainon held towards his suitors - did he?

Unless Mydei knew how Phainon felt and truly did not care.. But that didn’t sound like Mydei either, so he honestly had to shrug off those worries in his head. Not daring to pay them any mind in favor of blinking at Mydei widely, “Ah! But we’re best friends, I would feel bad if I left you alone!”

Mydei went silent at that as well - eyes only continuing their pointed stare all before he made an odd clicking noise with his tongue. As if he were giving up on trying to figure out Phainon’s true thoughts with just a single look that burnt into Phainon’s skin. 

“.. A few people in my life as of recently have.. Been murdered and I..” Mydei hushedly began, clearly lowering his voice so other people would not linger and listen in. Though, Phainon would growl at them and make them continue walking if any of the crowd did stop to gawk at the duo of princes.

But Phainon was a common sight in Okhema, it’s not like he had many people fighting to see him and talk to him nowadays. If anything, Mydei probably was the more interesting one if not for the way people also knew he was their prince’s childhood friend. Mydei wasn’t really that uncommon of a sight in Okhema either.. Or.. At least, he didn’t used to be. 

But Mydei only continued, sighing as he moved to cross his arms over his chest - brows knitting as he seemed to focus on his own words and thoughts, “I feel like I’m almost connected to them, even though the methods used for their murders were completely different.”

Ah.

Connected?

Well, Mydei certainly was, but it wasn’t as if Phainon could confess such a horrible thing to the man he adored. If anything, he only had to feign his innocence, blinking at the alpha who was still staring at him. 

.. Suspicious?

Mydei was suspicious of him? Was that it? But how? Phainon hadn’t left any traces on either, why would Mydei assume that Phainon was doing something to them? To people he knew? They were best friends, to anyone else, it shouldn’t look like Phainon was hurting anyone that Mydei may grow to love and care for but.. Even that made Phainon move a hand to scratch his own arm idly.

“I don’t think it’s fair to yourself to blame yourself somehow for their deaths, Mydei..” Phainon murmured instead, shaking his head slowly all while staring into those fierce amber eyes - looking at the way the specks of gold sparkled when the sunlight hit them. All while they still were glaring such daggers at him, maybe not on the surface.. But in the silence.. 

“It just.. It’s nothing.” Mydei huffed out, flicking his eyes back to the petting zoo and clearly giving up on trying to figure out Phainon for now. And that was enough to make Phainon sigh - a victory won, but he still needed to comfort this alpha regardless of the truth.

“Is it? You’re clearly distressed.” Phainon pointed out, moving a step closer to fully bump his own shoulder more obnoxiously into Mydei’s, “Let’s hang out, yeah? Just you and me, alone.”

Only, now that truly did earn a grouchy glare from Mydei towards Phainon over that - one that made Phainon almost whimper - but instead he gave a small laugh. 

“C’mon now, don’t look at me like that..” Phainon tried to speak softly, doing his best to coax this angry alpha who currently didn’t smell like much - emotions always somehow kept neutral in most cases to hide his true scent.

And that was always enough to drive Phainon insane.

He hated the way Mydei wore those scent blockers as an alpha, hiding his true thoughts under a lock and key that was on his neck and oh how painfully Phainon wished he had a key for that lock.. Alas, all he could do was smile with good intentions at him instead. 

“Sure, we’re both grown, but we can spar and have fun together at this festival just like everyone else; Can’t we?” Phainon purred out, practically whispering his words in such an intoxicating way that an omega would surely find it enchanting. Mydei, however, only looked at him with widened eyes, “After all, Okhema did send you this invitation with the hopes you would enjoy yourself freely!”

Mydei was silent for a moment, his jaw clenching and unclenching rather blatantly as he tried to think of what to say in this scenario. Doing his best to figure out how to probably decline Phainon. But Phainon had come here with one goal in mind, and that was solely to bother the crown prince of Kremnos who had accepted his invitation so sweetly. 

“Are you sure you wouldn’t rath-”

Mydei swallowed harshly over that - so forced that Phainon could see the way his own Adam’s apple had bobbed over the movement, “.. So you want to hang out for.. Political gain?”

“.. I see.”

Was Mydei becoming jealous? Did he think Phainon had many other people he would do that for to get political gain? Really? Hand holding?

“Don’t look so disappointed! I would choose to spend my time with you no matter what! Even if you weren’t a crown prince, you know?” Phainon chirped out, not even hesitating as he stole that hand again with a much rougher motion this time. Both hands on it as he kept it close to himself greedily. 

Mydei’s eyes flickered between those fingers wrapped around his own hand - before settling on Phainon’s face again, “Do I know?”

Only to be met with such a serious expression on Mydei’s face, hardened and flat as he stared right back at Phainon. As if this was such a daunting topic they both were about to approach and..

Phainon could only slowly and quietly echo out that word questioningly; “.. Mutton?”

“Mutton eating competition. If you feel this way, then we should revel in the festivities just as anyone else would, shouldn’t we?” Mydei pointed out, an eyebrow quirking up to his hair line as his eyes moved a certain way - making Phainon copy and look to where Mydei was trying to hint towards. 

Eyes catching the small building that clearly had ‘mutton eating competition’ written on the front of a banner in beautiful golden ink. That white banner hung above the rafters, all while two other people already were sitting down. Obviously a couple, but if anything.. That made his hand tighten on Mydei’s own possessively, full on grinning now as he dragged that man forward.

“I couldn’t agree more!” Phainon chirped out as he took the lead still and continued dragging him forward - borderline humming with every step he took closer to that little stall outside of Okhema’s walls. 

And Phainon didn’t even wait a single second as the stall worker seemed to straighten himself out - looking almost nervous as his eyes darted between the two princes. All before Phainon spoke before he could, “Two competitor seats, please!”

“Goodness me! Two princes on our hands.. Aren’t we the lucky ones?” The man immediately fired back, making Phainon give a friendly laugh over that - trying his best to ignore the burning jealousy he was starting to feel as he smelled it. The way this friendly man was an alpha.. Surely, Phainon was better than that - instead squeezing Mydei’s hand a bit roughly. 

“I’d argue I’m the lucky one today! A foreign prince giving me all his attention.. Aren’t I fortunate?” Phainon purred the words out, hoping that he seemed more than merely a little pleased - even if he could feel the way Mydei was scowling at him from his side.

“.. You act like we have not been friends for years.” Mydei grumbled out, making Phainon blink from that man who was idly listening in on their conversation and looking to Mydei. Hoping his look of innocence was enough as he gave a warm smile to that angry seeming alpha. 

“Friends, equals, and rivals. I will be eating more than you on this day, Mydeimos!” Phainon nodded with his own words, already dragging Mydei’s feet forward to take their seat the man obviously was going to say they could have - yet found no spare second to bring it up to them.

Not that Phainon minded as he made Mydei 

“Such a bold claim..” Mydei quietly said under his breath, earning a small grin from Phainon as they both sat down silently.

Only for Phainon to prop his head on his hand using the table - staring at Mydei with a smug grin on his face over the fact Mydei was sitting barely a foot away from him. 

“I have quite the insatiable appetite towards things or people I enjoy, you know?” Phainon wasn’t really asking, but Mydei’s eyebrow shot up regardless of that fact. Instead, it seemed like he had more questions than answers about such an idea. 

“.. And mutton is one of those things?”

Instead, he remained propping his head up, blinking at the rather coy looking Kremnoan crown prince who was sitting there with his arms crossed now; “Not particularly, but.. Someone I am very fond of will be there!”

Mydei stared at him over that, a few beats of a second too long before his eyes moved away silently - focusing instead on the man taking the stage now as he spoke one singular word; “.. Okay.”

.. Was love and romance between them that bad of an idea?

The other duo however laughed and giggled over those words as Phainon leaned off the table - eyes not daring to look at those mates that he would assuredly feel jealous over..

Nothing.

Sharp canines ripping and tearing into every piece of mutton with such an ease that Phainon almost felt like he was in danger of those fangs biting his neck out. Making him cut glances at Mydei hungrily devouring the meat to his side - effortlessly staying clean with slitted golden eyes entranced into a deep focus.

How?

Not that Phainon cared about that, instead chuckling quietly over the Mydei just seemed pleased he had beat Phainon anyway.

“Keep dreaming, then.” Mydei scoffed out, seeming amused just as much as he seemed like he was going to his Phainon for insinuating he would ever allow that.

.. Phainon wouldn’t want to use his hair like that either, mind you.

Phainon couldn’t help but bump his arm into Mydei’s as he laughed again over that, grinning at the alpha who seemed to be tutting at him quietly; “You’re that eager to be in my dreams? Awe, you should have said something!”

Feeling as if he was already growing addicted to this, addicted to the way Mydei was by his side again. Easily laughing and enjoying himself, just like when they were younger.

Just like when Mydei was once his.

Phainon only tilted his head to the side,“Ho? You think someone else could beat us? Where has your Kremnoan pride gone, Mydeimos?”

“I merely meant we are not.. As synced as we once were.” Mydei replied rather quickly - as if he were a little insulted by insinuation, but Phainon couldn’t blame him for that one. 

As synced as they once were.. That much was true as Mydei was seemingly trying to find someone that could replace Phainon anyway..

Not that it would stop Phainon though, instead making him beam a wide smile over the idea of them floundering around together anyway; “Hmm? This is the perfect time to practice, then!”

“Phainon-”

“Too late,” “Hello there! I’d like to sign myself and my partner up.”

“Partner?”

“For the race, silly. Don’t sound so offended.”

“I just..” Mydei trailed off, apparently giving up on that venture as he instead started to walk away - something that made the man working the booth give a raised brow over. As if to say ‘you’re letting your mate walk away like that?’ and Phainon had no idea how to raise a brow that would say ‘he’s not my mate but I really wish he was’ back to him..

Instead, he could only hastily snatch the rope from the boothwalker and chase over that alpha - not wasting a single moment as he laughed over the reluctance in Mydei; “Where are you trying to worm off to? Come here, I’m tying us together so you don’t even have a choice.”

“.. It’s very muddy on the track.” Mydei fired back - and Phainon’s eyes moved to the small little straight line of a course, noting that it was probably on purpose to make it harder. 

All before Phainon moved his eyes back to Mydei, not even hesitating as he took a knee - kneeling to tie his left ankle to Mydei’s right nimbly, “Mm.. It would be unfortunate if you fell, you look so pretty today.. Much like every other day, but who is looking besides me?”

“You’ve always been the charmer, you dog.” Mydei grumbled out, sounding less than a little pleased as he spoke those words - but Phainon could only laugh as he realized Mydei had led him to the starting line anyways.

So much bite for a lion who was more than a little willing to play his games with him..

“Just for you!” Phainon said with a wink as he finished tying himself to Mydei - looking up at those narrowed golden eyes as he himself straightened out again. Moving to stretch idly as his eyes looked at the little track set out outside Okhema..

Muddy.

It was so muddy that Phainon had to huff over the way he was always forced to wear white and blue as Okhema’s prince, Mydei’s outfit undoubtedly worked better for hiding mud and dirt stains.

.. Not that Phainon had any intentions of letting Mydei leave this festival covered in grime, anyway. 

“I doubt that much.” Mydei hissed at him, and that made Phainon laugh as he bumped his shoulder into that man - trying to hold in most of his laughter to draw less attention from the other contestants. 

But he didn’t really mind, if anything, Phainon enjoyed how warm and close Mydei was - how it felt like everything was okay again. He had the urge to even knit their fingers together lovingly during this, but all eyes would be on them from the passerbys..

.. Wasn’t that more reason to do it? To try to stake his claim on the alpha who kept tiptoeing away?

If they were both normal alphas, not people having to care for their public perception - he easily would have.. Alas..

All he could do was throw him a dazzling smile; “Hmm? Why would you ever doubt my words, Mydeimos? I’m very loyal to you!”

“Are you?” Mydei asked, sounding almost pointed - as if he was perturbed even by Phainon saying those words.

And whether it was a joke or not, Phainon found his mind reeling over it; “Huh?”

“Nothing, the race is about to begin.” Mydei growled at him with such a level of bite that Phainon’s mind puzzled over those words - but he was useless to try to voice those concerns as a silly little bell rang out again.

“Left.” Mydei immediately said, but Phainon didn’t move - instead he blinked over the way their lefts were the same, sure.. But Phainon’s..

“Which left? My left is tied to your right foot..” Phainon asked, still staring at their tied together ankles and fully ignoring the other people making a mess and already starting their rhythms. Mydei’s jaw visibly twitched over that, clenching and unclenching as if he was trying to decide something all while he glared at Phainon.

Halfway looking like he wanted to strangle Phainon, while also not being sure if Phainon was in the wrong here either, “The free foot.”

“Tied.”

And that's how their own slow and steady pace was set with the gritted words from Mydei leading them along - making Phainon feel a little amused over the situation as they were already falling behind. But maybe the true victory to be earned here was going to be not falling into the mud messily.

“Free.”

“Tied.”

“Free.”

“You know, you’ve become way more demanding with age.” Phainon cut in with a laugh, only nothing prepared him for how effortlessly that had thrown off Mydei - making him throw a stunned look to Phainon.

Only, Phainon hadn’t stopped, instead moving to drag Mydei along with him.

.. If not for the mud making them both so much more slippery.

“Mydeim-” Phainon didn’t really finish his words, not as Mydei instead seemed to give out over pure shock or something - all he knew was how quickly he  moved to take the brunt of that stumble. Enough to put himself beneath the man completely on his back - trapped beneath the fellow alpha in a blur of messy movements.

Wet.

His back felt so horribly drenched against the wet mud, and he could hear people laughing over the tumble - but Phainon’s eyes were stuck on the dumbstruck looking Kremnoan prince. He seemed like he hadn’t predicted their fall at all, wide and almost stunned as his arms were caging around Phainon to keep himself up.

And Phainon didn’t mind that at all - not as he had a wonderful view of staring Mydei in the eyes and taking in the way his golden and red hair framed his face. That braid dangling there as he kept himself slightly above Phainon’s own face, and Phainon had to bite down the urge to grab that braid and rub his fingers against it..

Instead, he could only give a small smile over how silly they probably looked together. 

“You’re heavier than I remember, you know?” Phainon breathed out, unable to stop the breathy laughter that bubbled up inside of him over this awkward position. Taking in the tangle of limbs and how Mydei really was resting on him almost tensely. Stiff.

And Phainon.. If they weren’t being laughed at and mocked currently - he would have found himself wrapping his arms around that alpha to beg him to stay just a few moments longer. He didn’t mind the laughter from the crowd - if anything, he would take that a hundred times over Mydei leaving him again. 

Instead, Mydei moved off of him immediately at those words - eyes avoiding eye contact as he muttered a singular word; “.. Sorry.”

“Don’t worry about it, I have to make sure my guests are all taken care of in my land - don’t I?” Phainon asked with another bubbling set of laughter leaving him as he copied Mydei in standing up again and straightening himself out.

Mydei seemed less than enthused over that, just like normal as he instead pressed out the word instead of actually laughing with Phainon; “Ha..”

Something about it was odd.

The rest of the race was filled with daunting silence from the other alpha, but not only that, he had gone so horribly rigid at Phainon’s side. Tense, like he was frightened by something - or he had merely realized something Phainon hadn’t as they worked their way to the finish line. 

And Phainon could only pray he was overthinking things due to some mud getting into his brain with the fall or something..

“Last..” Mydei finally spoke as they made it to the end of that silly race - making Phainon give a small laugh over that. Already moving to untie them both and free the pouty seeming crown prince with deft fingers.

“Last isn’t that bad! I had a lot of fun! Besides, at least you also lost right beside me.” Phainon pointed out, not even looking up as he untied that knot he had made.

Only, Mydei seemed to be a bit bothered by all of that; “You’re.. Covered in mud.”

“I.. I don’t think we need to do anything else together.” Mydei mumbled out - sounding so very disheartened as Phainon stood up again, idly keeping that rope in his hands to give it back to the person working there.
