“Phainon can..” Mydei trailed off, sounding as if this was killing him inside as his eyes flickered away - brows knitting in his own thoughts, “You just leave me alone for a bit?” 

Phainon’s fingers tightened into a ball over that - dented fingernails digging into his own skin, “Ah..”

“I’m sorry I just.. I need time away from you, I think.” Mydei told him, and for once in his life, he could smell the dissatisfaction in the alpha’s scent. As if he were souring with his unhappiness towards Phainon and today.. 

But.. Phainon was stuck on those words.

Time.. Away?

Phainon found himself almost gnawing his tongue over that, chewing on it idly as he tried to understand why the mood had shifted so horribly. 

“But we’ve always made such a good team, haven’t we?” Phainon asked innocently, giving a small laugh over it all - moving a hand to rub the back of his hand only to touch something so wet and slimy. Out of pure instinct, he moved to look at his hand - blinking at the mud there that had clung to him.

All while Mydei looked at it just as well, his expression looking harrowed and sorrowful - all before looking at Phainon in the eyes. Studying him, only for a brief moment before.. His face softened in such a horrible way that Phainon knew it was forced, that he was doing his best to swallow some grim reality down.

And nothing quite prepared Phainon for learning what that may be. 

“.. I think today showed.. Those days are gone now, Phainon. Let’s just.. Do our best to continue our lives.” Mydei’s eyes flickered away at that, looking like he had more to say as his jaw moved uncomfortably. As if he couldn’t settle his teeth in his mouth, all before whispering out one singular word to finish his thoughts off. 

“Separately.”

Separately.

That was an innocent word in itself, one that meant almost nothing yet it meant the entire world for Phainon now. It had since the moment Mydei had turned away and left him alone, left him there to stare after Mydei, fingers twitching as he debated chasing down that alpha who had swiftly broken away and distanced himself even though..

Phainon hadn’t thought the day went badly at all.

Even as he tried to sit there every single day that passed afterwards, trying his best to understand what he did wrong - he thought that day had been wonderful?

Mydei had laughed, squeezed his hand, let Phainon be close to him, all the way up until their fall. Did he do something wrong?

Was it because Mydei wanted to catch him instead romantically to try to sweep him off his feet just as Phainon had done to him?

He didn’t understand.

“Phainon? Are you alright?” Cyrene asked, but Phainon found himself leaning on the marble wall lazily, trying his best to hold in a yawn that was threatening to escape him yet again as he thought over that day. Clearly not buying that incredibly simple lie that had been said from Phainon himself over that. .. And now he was trying his best to keep himself glued together as life continued on, trying to be normal.

.. Perhaps hatred was too harsh of a word for it, it was merely.. Not love, and to Phainon that burned just the same as hatred did from someone else. .. He still wasn’t sure what he had done wrong.

“I see.”

.. What a scary skill to possess, but Phainon wasn’t someone that should be allowed to judge her for her or anyone else’s bizarre talents anymore.

Shuffling his weight between his feet as he was very aware of his sister behind him eagerly watching their conversation as she clipped another thorn rather loudly. “It’s unlike you to eavesdrop." Phainon immediately countered, coughing a little to clear his throat over how embarrassing this topic was. 

“Is it? Or have you just never caught me before?” Aglaea asked and equally teased, and Phainon was pretty sure it was unlike her to eavesdrop. 

Pretty sure, he couldn’t say anything for certain when considering the way she seemed to have threads in this world like a spider connecting everyone. Almost like a web of sorts that Phainon’s head hurt to even think about for too long at a time.

“Hrk..” Phainon whimpered out, moving to immediately rub his hair back over those words - trying to look anywhere but at those piercing multicolored eyes. 

Aglaea didn’t seem to mind however, pressing out a soft exhale before beginning again; “Regardless, this topic is just a bit fascinating to myself in specific.”

“Would you like some tea, Lady Aglaea?” Cyrene cut in, making Phainon feel the way he stiffened over his sister leaning over the railing now - clearly more interested in the topic at hand than the actual gardening she was one doing.

And he couldn’t really blame his sister for that, even if it was driving him insane currently as his eyes flickered between both girls.

Aglaea shook her head over the question however, eyes never straying too far from Phainon - even as she wore a small comforting smile towards Cyrene’s sweet offer; “Perhaps in a few moments, Princess Cyrene.. There’s something much more pressing, after all.”

“Like what?” Phainon instantly asked, feeling his body still burning with the stress of this topic. The fact Aglaea had found out who he loved and now seemed more interested in it, as if she had something to say about it all and that..

.. That was bizarrely terrifying for Phainon to consider. 

“‘Both alphas’ were the words Phainon just used in regards to himself and Mydeimos.” Aglaea started, seeming as if she had a planned course here - and Phainon found himself tilting his head over that expectantly. 

“Yes?”

Aglaea’s eyes fell squarely onto him, blinking over the way Phainon appeared nervous without a doubt - but he didn’t have it in himself to be able to hold that back. Instead looking as antsy as he felt, holding his expressions on his sleeve easily.

All while she said the words that made his blood freeze; “Mydeimos Gorgo is not an alpha.”

Not.. An alpha?

“.. What do you mean?” Phainon immediately found himself questioning, not able to hold himself back at all as he stared for more information - feeling the cold sweat that was brewing on his skin. Doing his best to try to ignore it as he considered the possibilities that would follow behind those words. 

“The crown prince of Kremnos is an omega that has been seeking out an alpha to mate with.” Aglaea began, and those words made Phainon feel as if he were going insane with every new one that he understood the meaning of, “I learned this at the rapid courting and was a bit more confused and pondered if the one you were truly desiring was not that man..”

She paused, only to give a small sigh and shake of her head over the way Phainon was undoubtedly staring at her like a hawk. Watching her every move, her every breath to try to see if she was lying about this topic. It was unlike her to lie, but he .. Something about this was so unbelievable.

Had he really.. Completely misread Mydei’s scent and secondary gender for years..?

“I felt off about it considering the way you stared at him the rest of the night, but you continuously claimed the lover you yearn for is an alpha.” Aglaea murmured as she moved to cross her arms over her chest - pursing her lips a little as she seemed to focus on those memories.

“So forgive me for overhearing a private conversation, but that man is not an alpha.” Aglaea told him, sounding so painfully serious that Phainon found his breathing halting in his lungs. Hands going numb as the weight of those words sank heavily into his heart.  

Yet Aglaea didn’t stop there, “If I had to wager any bets on this matter, I would assume he is a broken hearted omega trying to mate with anyone so he may move on.”

“B.. Broken hearted?” Phainon slowly echoed out, finding himself stunned over this entire situation and how this was the news being delivered to him just this once. An earth shattering discovery that made him feel like he was drowning, all while trying to scramble to scratch the ice at the surface.

“The prince of Okhema is known to reject every single beta and omega who asks for his hand in marriage through letter.” Aglaea began to explain, and Phainon wanted to beg her to stop.

To not explain anymore.

“And Mydeimos is an omega, who you have assumed is an alpha.”

He didn’t need it explained, not anymore, not as the dread settled into his body as Aglaea finished her thoughts on the matter. The dread of knowing where she was going with all of this, and what she was implying had already happened here between Phainon and Mydeimos. 

“.. Have you ever considered that you may have already rejected his love?”

“Phainon,” Phainon had to jerk his head upwards from his parchment paper over that - quill stilling as he met the gaze of his equally blue eyed sister, “This is the sixth letter you’re written this week.”

Phainon’s eyes moved back to the letter he was conjuring up over that - eyes dancing along the gold lettering on the paper with a heavy sigh escaping him over it. Another letter confessing his feelings that he had already confessed a hundred times before in their childhood, another letter begging to be allowed one more chance to set it right, and another letter promising that he would never fail Mydei again as his alpha like he had this time.

.. It was the least he could promise.

“I’m merely trying to check in on him!” Phainon sang out in a sing-song voice, feeling a little enthused when he considered the idea of Mydei replying to at least one of them. Whether to deny his requests, or to accept - at least he would have an answer finally. 

“.. It’s Monday." Cyrene pointed out, but that was fine, he didn’t care if it was just Monday and he kept sending letters.

Phainon had learned one thing about Mydei - he was stubborn in his own way. Not in the way that it would frustrate you, but in the respectable way that if he chose a path with his heart and mind he would stay true to himself and not become spineless.

.. Even if that may in fact be a little annoying for Phainon’s current situation that was unfolding with him.

“I’m worried.. He keeps avoiding me…” Phainon wistfully sighed out as he dropped his quill to the side - just to prop his head up on the wooden desk that sat in the corner of his room, perfectly angled to look at the doorway, “I’ve heard Queen Gorgo is looking into arranged marriages for him again..”

Phainon was idly speaking, feeling his mind racing already again over the idea of Gorgo trying so hard to find someone for Mydei..

“Should I send some letters to her instead? Beg for his hand in marriage? Or just go there and fall to my knees instead?” Phainon asked along with his thoughts that were ramming into his skull - eyes only able to blink at Cyrene as he studied her. Looking for any expressions to give him a hint towards her thoughts on this topic.

“Are you sure he’s an omega like Aglaea said?” Cyrene asked innocently, and that was enough to make Phainon move a hand to his arm - roughing scratching at in his normal anxious habit he had formed. Dented nails borderline cutting into his own skin from how often he scratched at himself, skin raw and torn - and yet it couldn’t compare to how fractured his sanity was beneath the surface now.

That question didn’t help to aid his sanity either - instead making him blink at Cyrene and study the way even she looked nervous now, “When has Aglaea ever been so cruel as to lie to me about something like this? And she said Mydei himself claimed to be an omega..”

Cyrene seemed to knit her brows over that - as if she had more to say, “That’s true.. But..”

“If he’s an omega, and I turned him down, I probably crushed him.” Phainon interrupted, all to give a shallow bark of laughter before dragging both of his hands up to his head to ruffle his own hair harshly. Grasping at his scalp and scratching at it there as well.

“I probably hurt him in a way I can’t understand, and now I have to try to chase him down to fix it.” Phainon explained, murmuring those words beneath his own breath almost as he thought about their recent interactions, “I was practically gloating and chasing him around all while he was in sorrow and thinking I was teasing him or something. I mean, imagine being in love with someone and they reject you only to keep coming around you and scenting you. I was rubbing on him and holding him close an-”

“Phainon, breathe.” Cyrene told him gently, cutting him off and making him drop his hands from his head - just to place him on the desk in front of him and stare at his palms useless. Eyes burning, just as they always had been lately.

Every time he thought of how badly he must have hurt Mydei, his mind spiraled and made him want to topple over and spill his lunch - it made him want to break down and weep. It made him wish he could undo everything he had done that possibly could have hurt Mydei. Ignoring that letter for his hand was merely the start, how much worse had it gotten?

“.. Anyway, I hurt him really badly, I know that much for a fact now.” Phainon tried to speak in a collected manner, even if he was sure he was speaking too pointedly - sharp and aggressive, even if he couldn’t help himself.  “A few hundred letters begging to see him and explain myself can't hurt me nearly as brutally, even if he hasn’t been replying to them.”

Only, Cyrene didn’t say anything over that for a few long and dramatic seconds, instead shuffling her weight between her feet in the doorway; “.. He’s..”

“Hmm?” Phainon pressed, a bit keen to hear whatever she had to say about Mydei - leaning his head to the side as he watched his sister’s eyes flicker around nervously.

“Queen Gorgo has.. Found an eligible alpha willing to marry him.”

Ah.

That’s..

“.. Hmm?” Phainon repeated his humming, acting as if he couldn’t understand the words she had just said to him. As if they didn’t add up, even though he had been told them before already - that he was being replaced by someone else and Mydei may be gone forever. 

Cyrene only blinked at him, “I was.. Invited to the wedding.”

“.. Was I not?” Phainon asked, but the answer was obvious considering he hadn’t heard of this before - almost making himself bite back a laugh to realize Mydei was avoiding him. Not replying, not wanting to see him, no longer inviting him to the wedding unlike his other one.

.. Mydei was trying to abandon him.

“No, I don’t believe so.” Cyrene conceded, even though Phainon didn’t need that confirmation. Not really.

Not as he rose from his desk coldly and moved past her, giving a small little laugh all before she spoke; “I see.”

“Where are you going?” Cyrene asked, turning in the doorway to watch him go, and Phainon.. 

“.. To ask Mydei about it all, personally.” Phainon told his sister with a simple little smile - one that he hoped could mask the way he could feel himself snapping. Whatever sanity he had left was probably quickly slipping from his fingers as he realized this wasn’t enough. 

It never would be.

Every step was another warning to his mind that if he kept hesitating, if he continued allowing this to happen - Mydei may actually slip away forever and replace him.

And for what?

Was their love not mutual like Phainon had always thought? Phainon needed to be told that by Mydei himself if that was the case - he needed to flat out hear Mydei say they would never be lovers. That he had moved on, and Phainon needed to do the same.. But Phainon couldn’t do that until Mydei himself told him to do that.

He needed to be rejected, or accepted - but never knowing for certain was going to kill him.

.. But the first thing he needed to investigate was easily the person Mydei was now arranging to marry.

That was an easy first step, of course, as every movement he made seemed automatic as soon as he nosily asked people who Mydei was marrying - acting like he had simply not met the man before. Well, he hadn’t, but he didn’t need them to know he also lacked an invitation.

That was simple, however. A smile there, a grin over here - anything to look more welcoming than he actually felt, especially as he felt his mind struggling more and more. Faking his happiness was simple - of course, but doing his best to stay sane was impossible. Even if he was able to lie and give a false sense of security.. 

He felt like his mind was snapping every time someone brought up the fact it was Mydei’s marriage, that he was the one being wedded and even Phainon’s own tongue burned as he mentioned it. 

Made even more bitter and vile, venomous to his throat as he thought about the fact Mydei was an omega.

Not an alpha, he was someone who could truly take a mating bite and be gone forever from Phainon with no chance of getting him back. That made everything more time sensitive as Phainon stalked the halls of this foreign castle, not really caring for the way people may be curious as to where he had gone in his own kingdom.

They would be fine, his own mental state if this wedding was not dealt with, however.. 

“This is getting.. Less and less personal every time I do this..” Phainon murmured as he slowly lowered himself in a crouch - eyes dully staring at the man who was face down on the floor. A person he hadn’t even needed a second glance at - just a few people calling him their prince as confirmation that he needed to die.

A quiet night of stalking his prey, all to simply drive his blade home and end their life swiftly.

And arguably boringly. 

“I didn’t even need to see your face..” Phainon whispered, feeling as if he shouldn’t laugh - and yet he did. A quiet little jagged chuckle that rubbed his own throat sore as it left his lips in a numbing fashion, as if his heart and mind were completely conflicted on what to do right now.

That was fine, if he was moving on auto pilot, he at least would eventually end up at Mydei’s side - he knew that. Even if the trail of blood was long and haunting, at least.. At least eventually he would have that man back in his life.

“Just knowing his heart belongs to you is as good a reason as any.” Phainon mused, as if that logic made perfect sense - and really, he had to think to anyone with a brain it did make sense easily, “I used to have honor, fight fairly, sword to sword.. And now..”

He blinked over the way he had found this man alone, walking and reading papers - only to have a sword thrusted through his spine without a noise spared to out Phainon existence. Still cloaked in white, but always dousing himself in blood now - but he didn’t mind. 

That was simply how it had to go, and he found himself giving that same eerie laugh over his thoughts; “You didn’t even know I was here..”

Phainon sighed over it, moving a hand to rub at his own temples, “The worst part is that I just don’t care, either.”

“So what if I’m drenched in blood,” Phainon asked, remaining crouched there as he slowly moved a hand to knot into that man’s head of hair - bunching it up to pull his head off the floor lazily, “My beloved is Kremnoan, if anyone loves the color and smell of blood, it would be him.”

Phainon sighed over his own words, leisurely rising to his feet to remove that sword lodged in the man’s chest - only to feel frustration bloom in his chest in such a burning and heavy fashion. One that immediately made him drag that blade back into the man, again and again, again and again, until he completely lost count of how many times he had done that. Just to stand above that corpse mindlessly and stare at it - his entire life felt so fuzzy now, even if he tried to walk away.. Could he?

If anything..

“Omega or not, Alpha or not.” Phainon explained to that man, all before turning away - bloodied shoes carrying him to the one place he knew would be open to him, a place that he had always called home.

And those words in his mind only made him chuckle; “He’s mine.”

Home.

Mydeimos was his home, and even if Mydei had forgotten that fact over the years of politics and uptight leashes around his neck - Phainon didn’t mind. 

“He just needs to be reminded of that fact, at the end of the day.”

──────────────

Old and fraying due to time.

That’s what that white shirt was - years old and yet Mydei had kept it all these years to help soothe himself with the very distant scent of Phainon. Nowadays he wasn’t even sure if it had his pheromones anymore, or if it was merely Mydei’s hopeful mind tricking himself as he sniffed at it to try to get a whiff of the man he adored.

Adored.

And had to let go of - a struggle as for some reason that man had been flooding him with letters as of late. Letters Mydei hadn’t thrown out, but instead kept and couldn’t bring himself to open out of the daunting horror of the words that could be written in that fancy and elegant handwriting the man had. Even worse was the way he was almost sure Phainon had been scenting them.

Or they just smelled too much like him, whatever it was - it made Mydei’s stomach split his body in two as he felt himself yearn so deeply. A crippling emotion as he struggled to get over that man, to stop wishing he was at his side day in and out. Only reminded more and more of how it would never be. It could never be.

Only, his nightly struggles over wilting and suffering over Phainon abruptly ended as a rather polite knock at his door. A slow and measured thing that made Mydei huff over it.

Mydei shot up over that knock at his door - blinking at the dark oak wood as he moved to fix his nest silently. All before standing up to go answer it - mind expecting a maid or a guard to be checking in.

Not.. 

“Phainon?” Mydei began, eyes going wide as he tilted his head to the side in wonder over the vivid white haired man standing at his doorstep, “You smell like blood, are you alright?”

Smelled like blood.

But also, Mydei could physically see it on his clothes - a few drops on his cheek as well, enough to make Mydei knit his brows in worry over the sight. Especially as he lingered on Phainon’s face - feeling his mind reeling over the way Phainon looked exhausted. But not only that.. He smelled as if he was threatening someone, so territorial and overwhelming that after just a few mere moments he was covering the scent of blood with his own pheromones.

“Why are you even here right now? Come here.. You’re injured..” Mydei mumbled out, moving to grab Phainon’s arm and yank him into his bedroom a bit harshly.

He was supposed to be staying away from this man, sure, but he couldn’t help it when his instincts were flaring up to try to help him. To aid him in any way he could.. And regardless.. Phainon was the person he cared the most for, if he was hurt..

Mydei had to close the door after that alpha - locking it with a heavy sigh as he turned to look at the man he still had a hold of. Eyes slowly blinking as Phainon’s eyes trailed up Mydei’s arm that was holding onto him - just to pause as their eyes met. 

“You’ve been avoiding me.” Phainon rather flatly and coldly spoke - eyes devoid of any real emotion as Mydei instead flickered his own eyes away. Now that the door was closed, his scent was almost suffocatingly thick.

Mydei had to scrunch his nose over it - trying his best to focus on the more important things at hand; “.. A little, but,” Mydei admitted, pausing to move his hand slowly to Phainon’s cheek - trying to thumb away the dried blood there, “You have blood on you, are you okay?”

Mydei didn’t even know what else to say really - not when his mind was racing a mile a minute, stuck pondering over the blood and why Phainon was here in the first place. If anything, an eerie feeling of fear crept up his spine, almost as if he should be scared of that dejected and hollow looking alpha. 

Yet, Phainon only tilted his head to the side; “We were supposed to get married.”

Mydei’s mind reeled over that - pausing in its tracks as his eyes flicked to meet those icy blue eyes, his mind opening and closing a few times as he even tried to comprehend what was just said to him.

They.. Were supposed to get married? 

“.. Huh?” Mydei asked rather intelligently as he tried to understand why this man of all people would be saying that.

Phainon only kept his gaze - making Mydei feel almost uncomfortable as those blue eyes didn’t waver at all, didn’t betray his emotions even the slightest bit. It’s not like they had to, though, his scent alone was making Mydei feel like his insides were clawing nervously at his ribs to try to escape.

“You and I. It’s all I ever wanted, why did we.. Not become mates, Mydei?”

.. What kind of questions even were these? And why was Phainon the person to be asking them?

“You..” Mydei trailed off, taking a small step back - only that seemed to be the wrong move as that alpha instead quickly took many steps forward, closing the distance between them all to cage Mydei in against the door. Borderline slamming him into it as Mydei stared wide eyed into those now wild looking eyes. 

“What did I do wrong, Mydei?” Phainon asked, and Mydei wasn’t even sure what to do about this situation - staring at the man he trusted more than anything in this world. All while feeling pricks of fear over the blood on Phainon’s clothes and face - dried, not his own, someone else’s. All while looking at Mydei like he was prey to be hunted. 

Mydei swallowed painfully, feeling his throat almost choke as he stared at the slightly taller alpha - if anything, he could easily fight this man off. They were rather matching in sword combat, but Mydei was better in hand-to-hand combat.. It was just.. He didn’t want to fight this alpha.

He adored Phainon. 

“You.. You were the one who rejected me, not the other way around.” Mydei pointed out, trying his best to calm his nerves and look at the man’s attire more closely. Blood, but his sword was missing.. Where was his sword? What had he done?

“I wouldn’t do that.” Phainon almost growled out - making Mydei’s eyes snap up to look at those shock-blue eyes, taking in the way they still looked so devoid of emotion. Fiery, but for some reason so painfully hollow - as if he was already giving up on something, or nearing defeat.

“You d-”

“I didn’t.” Phainon repeated, sounding almost annoyed as he leaned closer to Mydei - just enough to barely make their foreheads touch all while Mydei felt like he was in a daze inhaling those pheromones deeply. “I didn’t read it.”

Too much.

Phainon was putting off too many pheromones, so blatantly trying to intoxicate whoever was smelling him and Mydei could only awkwardly move to tighten his thighs. Trying to stop the slick he felt leaking out of him as he tried not to sniff Phainon too much - trying to ignore the way his body yearned to lean forward and sniff at Phainon’s neck and lick the scent there.

“I didn’t read it. What did you say to me, Mydeimos? Did you confess to me in a letter?” Phainon only pressed further - making Mydei blink a little and try to understand the flurry of emotions that were rampaging through his own head. 

Lust was one, deeply turned on by the smell of this alpha trying to lure in a mate - but confusion was the other main one. Every time his eyes flicked to the blood on Phainon’s face he felt his heart skip a beat and rattle against his thorax in worry.

“Phainon?” Mydei questioned over those words - doing his best to try to stay calm as that alpha didn’t move at all - hands still at the side of Mydei’s shoulders and against the door. Keeping Mydei there, at least, because Mydei was willing to stay there anyway. 

“It’s just us here.. What did you say to me, Mydeimos?” Phainon repeated, his voice coming out just as controlled as ever - icy and demanding, “What did I reject? I thought you were an alpha, I spent day in and day out waiting for you and debating when I myself should ask for your hand, but..”

Mydei could only shallowly breathe over that - trying to figure out what he was supposed to say to this man who seemed more than a little distraught. A sour scent, an upset alpha, all while Phainon was so blatantly trying to sweeten his scent to sway any omegas at the same time. 

Trying to sway Mydei. 

But all Mydei could focus on was the uncomfortable twist in the depths of his stomach - agonizing over how upset this alpha was. Yearning to comfort him and try to copy him, sweeten his scent to try to soothe the alpha - but right now.. Something also had Mydei on edge; the odd chill in Phainon’s personality, calculated and cunning, things Mydei didn’t know to attribute to Phainon.

Why?

Phainon only continued his rambling at Mydei’s silence, “You aren’t an alpha.. You’re an omega who nests and has heats..”

Mydei knew that, of course he did, and maybe it was his fault for assuming Phainon had figured that out as well - only blinking at that alpha and trying his best to steady his own breathing. Doing his best not to focus on his mind becoming fuzzier and dizzier with that heavy alpha scent permeating the air. 

“Does anyone know you’re here Phainon? We need to check your wounds.” Mydei inquired, feeling his words come out in a ghost of his normal voice rather embarrassing - almost making  himself grimace but he had never been in this situation before. 

He had never had an alpha so deliberately trying to intoxicate him with their scent - pinning him to a wall and staring him down to watch his every move and breath. 

“I’m not wounded.” Was all Phainon coldly grumbled out, seeming almost annoyed that Mydei was bothering to ask.

Annoyed, until Mydei moved a thumb to Phainon’s face a bit timidly - brushing his jaw with his thumb to rub at the blood there; “Then.. This blood?”

And that was enough to make Phainon lean his head into that touch. A hum softly leaving Phainon’s throat as he closed his eyes - evidently enjoying the touch so very much and Mydei.. Tried not to think about that too much, instead focusing on how burning hot the alpha was to the touch.

Unwell.

Phainon was physically unwell, and probably mentally, but how was Mydei supposed to coax him into visiting a doctor right now? If anything.. He was pretty sure Phainon was sporting an erection, all from just standing here together - and Mydei could only swallow harshly as those shocking blue eyes opened to focus on him again.

A hand moving to cup over Mydei’s own and press him to splay his fingers out more against Phainon’s face; “Mydei, did I break your heart?”

Mydei’s breath halted again - trying not to stare into those piercing eyes as he felt Phainon rubbing his head against Mydei’s hand slowly; “That’s.. Where is the blood from?”

“The blood isn’t important, I just.. I need to know.” Phainon countered, and Mydei could easily argue the blood was most certainly more important than Mydei’s broken heart right now. But.. He also needed to calm this man down somehow, only being able to sigh over the question now. 

“.. Yes.”

Phainon didn’t move at that. 

His facial expression didn’t change - his eyes didn’t flicker. He only remained standing there keeping Mydei’s hand on his face. All before he hummed again, an odd and broken sound before he spoke; “I broke your heart?”

“Easily. Whose blood is that on you, Phainon?” Mydei pressed, doing his best to just move past that topic since it seemed to be causing more issues to Phainon’s mental state right now. 

If he hadn’t read the letters, there was a possibility he.. Had only just learned about this, then? That Mydei was an omega and that he had turned Mydei down already for marriage? Was that where the issue was really arising since Phainon had spoken about them becoming mates..?

“Mydeimos..” Phainon eventually whimpered out, obviously not caring about the question and caring more about Mydei’s heartbreak - but even that felt silly right now as Mydei tried to ignore the way that alpha was nuzzling into his hand now. 

“I’m more worried about the blood..” Mydei grumbled out, only to wrinkle his nose a little - tightening his thighs to try to stop the way he could feel himself making even more slick as Phainon’s scent became even more overbearing.

Too much, too wanting. Desperate to make an omega fall into a heat, and all Mydei could do was pull himself away from that man - away from the door and try to breathe cleaner air. Even if he was aware of the way that man was stalking after him silently, not keen on letting him avoid inhaling more and more of it to make Mydei’s mind become even more dazed.

Mydei had to shake his head over it all - doing his best to try to clear his own head as he looked at that man who was following him, not hesitating even a little. All while Mydei had to point it out; “Your.. Phainon your scent..” 

“Do you like it? If you’re an omega, you must enjoy this, right?” Phainon innocently asked, and that was enough to make Mydei’s breath stutter in his lungs as he was coming to terms with the situation. This man was truly trying to turn him on, trying to make him fall into a heat right here and now and..

Mydei wasn’t sure if he was in the best state to keep refusing him, or if he really even wanted to refuse that scenario at all. Instead, he tried to keep his voice calm and soft, still attempting to calm that rowdy alpha that was now in his bedroom with the door locked. 

“You.. You need to be checked up on..” Mydei pointed out, shaking his head some more as he moved a hand to card through his bangs nervously - doing his best to try to be sane as it appeared that alpha had no intentions of controlling himself. 

“Let’s get married, okay?” Phainon told him, making Mydei further aware that Phainon was not going to be normal or calm at all right now - that something had happened and that alpha was finally at his breaking point, “I need to.. I need to keep you in my life, I’ll do anything.”

Ah.

So it really was just over the letters and the rejection that Phainon apparently did not know about? It all was just.. Phainon getting frustrated beyond return? It wasn’t as if Mydei had much time to think about his reply - not as that hunting alpha slowly moved closer to him, following him over to his bed. 

“Do I smell good to you? Will you be mine, forever?” Phainon asked quickly, and Mydei could only look at the man - praying he couldn’t smell the slick dribbling down his thighs but.. Surely, Phainon could smell that on him.

“We can consummate our marriage tonight..” Phainon only continued, making Mydei stiffen as he blinked at that alpha - doing his best not to give away how badly he wanted that, “I’ll be gentle until you’re used to it.”

How desperately Mydei wanted to do that with him, just like he had always desired to be Phainon’s and his alone. And now he had a chance to, yet.. He wasn’t sure if this man was sane enough right now. Was it taking advantage of a distressed alpha currently?

Mydei loved Phainon, he always had loved him - and now that alpha was borderline offering himself up on a silver platter and all Mydei could feel was guilt in regards to it. Guilty that the man may just merely be out of his mind currently, mentally unwell and needing help. Not actually wanting Mydei like the omega wanted him..

Still leaning into it with eyes closed, as vulnerable as possible - yet trusting in Phainon fully, even regardless of his crimes and the trail of blood his footprints would leave behind.

Love.

This was love at its rawest form, a sort of contradiction to where Mydei knew Phainon had done things wrong - and yet he loved him. And yet he was so easily able to open himself up for him and sit naked in a bath with the man who had taken several people’s lives now.

.. But that too was an act of love, as twisted as they were, Phainon had acted out of selfishness - and love. 

“You say that, but it still works on you every time I do pout..” Phainon sighed as he pointed it out - a sigh, but a smug one due to the fact he knew he wasn’t wrong.

Mydei was many things, and being weak to having a mopey puppy following him around was arguably one of his biggest ones that Phainon had figured out as of late. 

“Be quiet.” Mydei mumbled out, shaking his head slowly, sounding like he was almost exasperated but Phainon had no intentions of stopping there.

Only sighing more wistfully and loudly; “I do love that braid, you know? It’s so very.. Mydei, to me. Like..” Phainon trailed off, thinking of all the years of being in the wheat fields near his actual home and seeing that crown prince playing with him.

That braid had always caught his eye, hair as golden as those fields with the edges on fire, ironic considering the eventual reality of kingdoms at war. Yet, that hair was attached to a person had become his home instead - a golden cuff dazzling him in the sunlight every time to help guide him home to him.

“I practiced tying braids for a bit with Cyrene in case you ever needed me to help braid it again - but that day never came..” Phainon mindlessly continued, blinking away his memories of a smiling prince that was now in front of him - a fully grown man who only was staring him down meticulously, still at his side, and still willing to listen to him; “Now to learn it’s a promise of yourself to me.. How could I not love it so much more than I already had before?”

Phainon hummed to move his hand back to those strands of slightly damp hair now - smoothing over them before a chuckle left his lips; “I can braid your hair in the mornings for you, if you’d like even. It would make me feel happy.”

Mydei didn’t really move for a few seconds - seeming just as lost in his own thoughts, and Phainon almost thought he was blushing, just a bit more. As if this topic was flustering to him for some reason, all before the omega huffed over the offer; “.. I don’t mind.”

“Mm..” Phainon hummed out, leaning away again just to prop his head on his hand - taking in the sight of how pretty his mate actually was, “Should I grow out some of my hair and make a braid on the side in a promise to you, as well?”

Even if he somehow ignored their bond and years together as children, Phainon was plenty sure he would have been swooning for this man either way. Head over heels for the gorgeous and eyecatching man who made people shush up when he entered the room.

Mydeimos from the kingdom of war, but barely seemed like he fit that picture outside of being strong and skilled in battle. In moments like these where Phainon could see his past bruises he inflicted onto Mydei’s skin, the outline of his own fingers from holding the omega still, he couldn’t see him as a leader of war.

Ironic, especially considering Mydei was currently doing anything to stop both of their kingdoms from going to war due to Phainon’s streak of murders. 

“You would look silly.” Mydei retorted, though he didn’t actively seem against the idea considering the slight uprise of his chest - a slight bounce to tattle on the fact he had chuckled just a little over the idea. 

“Would I?” Phainon asked, dropping his voice a little lower as he tilted his head to the side - feigning innocence as that omega rather blatantly eyed him up. Giving him a once over that always made Phainon’s nerves itch, praying that the omega still found him interesting and enticing - even doing his best to sweeten his scent for the omega.

Mydei seemed to have gotten a whiff of it - if the slight twitch of his nose was anything to go off of, making the omega reach for Phainon this time. A touch too gentle, chaste and kind in its nature as it moved Phainon’s bangs to the side of his face - wet and tacky enough to stay there for once. All while Mydei hummed over it; “Silly, but a very charming man.”

“Only for you.” Phainon told him, only for those golden eyes to latch onto Phainon’s own, immediately giving a bark of laughter that seemed to die down as soon as it left Mydei’s own lips. 

“I know.”

Phainon huffed a laugh at that, a breathy thing as he instead shuffled just the tiniest bit closer to Mydei; “Come here..”

And that was enough to make Mydei roll his eyes; “I’m not having se-”

“I want to braid your hair.” Phainon purred, aware of the way Mydei kept refusing to have sex today - probably out of stress, or out of fear that Phainon would trap him again inside his own bedroom for more than a mere few hours yet again.

But at those words, the omega went a little wide-eyed, just for the briefest moment, before obeying and pushing their bodies together even more. Enough to where Phainon could comfortably thread both his hands into those golden hairs nimbly.

“Mm..”

“An oath of my own, since you seem to not like the idea of my own hair..” Phainon explained, as his fingers already worked those hairs back into their braided position - not as if it would stay with how Mydei hadn’t washed his hair yet and that cuff was still resting on his clothes a few feet away. 

“Alright.. Let’s hear it then.” Mydei mumbled, blinking his heavy looking lashes as Phainon only moved to put their foreheads together - all to give a bubbly laugh over Mydei demanding to hear his promise to Mydei.

But Phainon had to hum playfully over that, “What? I can’t keep it a secret and tell you later?”

“I told you why I braided mine, you just were too foolish and forgot or didn’t listen to me, it’s a promise. Not a secret.” Mydei pointed out with a huff, but that only made Phainon laugh light-heartedly at that again. 

“.. You’ve braided your hair since I was ten, how was I supposed to remember that?” Phainon countered, feeling himself biting his tongue over his own words as Mydei’s eyes narrowed at him. 

“And I was eight. What’s your point?” Mydei hissed to him, and that was how Phainon found himself sighing as his fingers still looped a decent sized amount of Mydei’s hair together.

“You win this round..” Phainon conceded with a small laugh leaving him again, making him shake his head as he kept it pressed against Mydei’s own, “Alright, Mydeimos Gorgo.. I’m making my promise to you that I will always stay by your side, and I will love you, and only you, until the day that I die.”

“.. You sound really distraught saying that, you know?” Mydei told him in a soft and rather soothing voice, but Phainon knew that. Of course he did, he could feel his throat closing and suffocating him with every word he spoke to him.

Struggling to say those words, struggling to speak his mind.. Merely due to the fact that he had felt his heart breaking not even too long ago over this man - feeling as if it was already doomed before they were together. 

“I.. Just never thought I would actually be able to say those words to you, let alone while naked and braiding your hair for you as a symbol of that promise..” Phainon mumbled, trying his best to calm the shake in his tone and steady his fingers - all before dropping them down from the braid he had made. Blinking at it before flitting his eyes to Mydei’s own, taking in the way those eyes seemed to twinkle every time the light hit them. Not to mention how soft they looked.

All before Mydei laughed, pulling his own head away from Phainon’s; “It was cute until you brought up the fact we’re naked.”

“It’s still cute if you ask me, I think we’re the perfect couple.” Phainon huffed, shrugging his shoulders in a teasing fashion as Mydei faced forward yet again - letting Phainon watch the way those eyes closed slowly. 

Sleepy.

Mydeimos was getting sleepy, that much was obvious with how he sunk into the waters just a bit more - tired from his day of politics and assuredly trying to clean up the mess Phainon had made even if Phainon had said he would do it himself. 

Mydei sat there silently, all before finally speaking quietly above the waters; “What makes it perfect?”

“You and I together, that’s all that’s needed.” Phainon answered easily, and Phainon couldn’t help but playfully bump their shoulders together - drinking in the way Mydei’s eyes blinked open to flick to him leisurely. 

“Are you ever not sappy?” Mydei asked in a rather exhausted tone, one that only made Phainon lean into the side of the bath’s edge - chuckling a little as he nonchalantly moved an arm around the back of Mydei. Doing his best to tuck that man closer to him. 

“I’m not trying to be sappy, I’m just being honest.” Phainon told him in a light voice - airy and full of delight as he drank in the way Mydei’s head immediately lulled to hit Phainon’s shoulder. Laying there leisurely as Phainon continued speaking;  “As long as I have you, I think in this lifetime, I’ll be happy no matter what.”

“I’m glad you think that way, because you owe me years of replies.” Mydei mumbled, voice drifting off more and more into one of slumber at its edge - fraying quickly and becoming more and more hushed. 

“Ah.. Of course!” Phainon purred out, tightening his arm around Mydei just a bit, “I have all my years by your side to answer your letters I missed, don’t I?”

“You do.” Mydei confirmed, and all Phainon could do was nuzzle his own head into Mydei, finally, just pleased to have that man all to himself.

──────────────

“Mydeimos,” Phainon’s voice almost echoed in the now empty room, making Mydei’s eyes drop to the sleek trails of blood behind Phainon and pooling at his feet now. Messy and clinging to his shoes, all while Phainon didn’t move a muscle, “You aren’t supposed to be here, not right now.” 

Too much.

This was too much, something was assuredly wrong with Phainon - but Mydei wasn’t exactly sure what, considering they were now mates and Mydei.. Had no desire to leave him at all, so why did he feel the need to sneak off and add more and more to his counter of murders? 

“.. You aren’t either.” Mydei countered easily, watching that greatsword jerk just a bit - enough to sling a line of red blood across the quartz tiles beneath them. Tiles of royalty and prestige, now slowly being dyed a red hue as Phainon turned slowly to look at his mate. And Mydei was pretty sure he had expected this somewhere within himself - those hollow looking eyes and the way his own instincts screamed to comfort his mate. 

Only to not move, to continue standing there and blinking at the man who had just slaughtered two more people. “Did you follow me to scold me?”

 “Can you even stop yourself if I did scold you?” Mydei countered, biting back some snark about that comment and how annoyed Phainon sounded - even if he was bothered, it didn’t seem like Phainon would ever dream of trying to take it out on Mydei.

Or, well, at least they would spar. Not something as.. Demented as this.

 “.. No.” Phainon sighed, sounding much too dramatic as he moved his eyes back to the two corpses behind him, “I’m taking matters into my own hands, isn’t that fine?”

 “.. With our marriage, part of the blame will fall onto Kremnos.” Mydei informed him bluntly, even though he knew this wouldn’t be that bad, considering the fact it was.. Well..

Okhema.

That only made Phainon make an odd whimpering noise - a pathetic thing as he moved closer to Mydei, “Mydei..”

 “Phainon.” Mydei hissed right back, glaring a little as that man walked closer to him - that heavy blade scratching horribly against the beautiful and once flawless flooring behind him, “You’re bloody, do-” 

Mydei didn’t get to finish his thoughts before Phainon’s free hand moved to cup his cheek the tiniest amount upwards due to their very slight height difference. Just to silence him with a harsh and almost hungry feeling kiss - one that was much too devouring for Mydei’s own sanity as that alpha kept a hand on his greatsword’s blade.

A threat, not to Mydei - that much was obvious by how sweet the alpha’s scent was becoming to calm Mydei’s own nerves - but a threat to anyone else as he kept their lips pressed together. Sealing whatever Mydei had wanted to say into his mouth to instead fit their lips together like puzzle pieces as always.

Gentle, yet so very demanding from Phainon - clearly eager to make Mydei silence his own worries with affection. Just for Phainon to pull away - hand still resting tightly on Mydei’s chin before he hummed softly; “It’s okay.. My precious mate.. I’ll handle it, you know?” 

Handle it.

Mydei’s eyes flickered in the dark lighting to that slack greatsword in the man’s hand lazily, staring at it in the darkness with a minute interest - mainly due to the way it didn’t seem like Phainon had a decent grip on it at all.

If Mydei wasn’t so infatuated with him, if he had also been someone more sane of mind - he could have been able to hold this man down and cease his crimes; turn him in.

Instead, Mydei only moved his gaze back to Phainon’s own sharp vivid cobalt one, blinking at the way he was merely waiting for a reply from Mydei. 

“Cyrene-” 

“I’ll handle it all. You should go back to Kremnos and rest.” Phainon immediately interrupted regardless, not seeming like he desired to hear Mydei’s thoughts on the topic at all. Probably due to the fact he most likely had already thought and considered them himself.

Just to not care about them, undoubtedly.

Mydei hadn’t known Phainon to not care about others to this extent; Phainon could be headstrong and quick to action, sure, but he had never just been so.. Blatantly regarding the feelings and retributions of others that may happen.

.. So why?

“Rest? How am I supposed to when you sneak out nightly like this?”  Mydei asked mindlessly, trying his best to ignore the nagging and biting emotions in the back of his skull - instead focusing on the way that hand was now pressing a thumb into Mydei’s cheek slowly. 

Leisurely, calculatedly warm and soft - as if he was practically vying for Mydei’s attention to stay on him, in his own eyes and ignore others just as Phainon would do for him. 

Phainon took a moment at that, a brief second of solace and silence between them as the scent of blood lingered more and more heavily in the air with every passing second - only to give a small sigh and shake his head; “.. It’s not to do anything to betray your heart.”

As if that was possibly the issue as Mydei’s eyes moved back to that sword - taking in the way where even in the poorly lit space it glowed just a little. A soft reflection on the well kept and maintained metal, all to be used for murder.

Mydei had to sigh over it as that hand on his chin almost tightened, as if it was begging for Mydei to pay attention to his alpha instead of his blade one more, and all Mydei could do was obey that unspoken desire as he flicked his eyes to him.

 “I know that, but that doesn't make me any less worried.” Mydei sighed his explanation out, moving a hand to the one that was resting on his own chin gently - barely ghosting a grip onto Phainon’s wrist, “Come home with me.” 

“Mydeimos..” Phainon said in a quiet tone, almost as if he was going to argue against it - probably stay the night in Okhema if anything, but that would only lead to more questions considering how the council assuredly knew of Phainon’s actions as of late.

.. Whether they approved or not of his methods remained something Mydei was not privy to, however. But judging by the corpses behind Phainon, he could at least assume more than a few were not.. Thrilled.

Mydei only had to harden his resolve over that, gripping onto his mate’s wrist tightly, “Come on.. I’ll reward you, so put up your sword for this week and come to bed with me.” 

Phainon didn’t move at that.

He didn’t do as much as blink for a few long and stretched moments, all before slowly tilting his head to the side as if he didn’t quite understand what Mydei was going on about; “.. It will be dawn by the time we arrive.” 

“No one will question if I demand more time with my new alpha. Come home.” Mydei pointed out and demanded with a heavy sigh leaving his lips - because that much was true. No one said much if he was spending time with Phainon alone, not when he already had a mating bite seared into his flesh and an urge to be at that man’s side always. 

Phainon closed his eyes at that, looking at if he was heavily debating something because he leisurely laughed, dragging that sword against the floor for a horrible scratching noise to follow his movements.

“You’re unwell, Mydei. With how willing you are to lie for me and cover up for me..” Phainon purred out those words, and Mydei had to  ball his fist up to stop the urge to wrinkle his nose and sniff at that alpha as the air became even heavier with his scent. 

“It takes two to make a relationship work.” Mydei pointed out, and although he did think that - he had to bite back the urge to start dragging this man back.

Even if Phainon was their prince, Mydei had no idea what sort of limits this kingdom would enforce upon him for these acts of treason. If anything, he was growing more and more on edge as they remained here with blood gathering at their feet. 

They couldn’t remain here forever, and Mydei desperately at the very least did not want to be caught here.

“Even if I..” Phainon’s hand moved from Mydei’s chin at that, instead moving to grab at his sword dully - lifelessly, as if he were moving automatically and by instinct as he showed Mydei that beautiful blade. Dyed crimson currently, but still shining as elegantly as it ever had when they had sparred as children.

Well taken care of and adored, all to be used for such senseless murders that Mydei had to bite his inner gums over it - gritting his teeth as he flitted his eyes to focus on that alpha in his entirety.

It wasn’t the first time he had seen Phainon with blood on him, and he had a feeling it would not be the last time at all. 

Mydei could only shake his head over it; “You’re a messy man.” 

“I didn’t used to be.” Phainon spoke in such a cold tone that Mydei was pretty sure something inside of him was cracking by now - shattering under the icy layer to reveal that still woeful little farmer boy who was turned into a prince. 

“Maybe we should put down the sword and start sorting our letters, then.” Mydei huffed, and now he was a bit more painfully aware of those tears now streaking down Phainon’s face as the alpha dropped that sword to his side again. 

Head hanging dejectedly, all before he merely mumbled out a laugh beneath his breath. 

“.. Haha.” 

Mydei had to move at that, just a bit closer to comfortably wipe those hot tears away with his thumb with a heavy sigh over how he felt as if he was comforting a sad and heart broken man. Not.. Someone who had just taken the lives of more people. 

“Good boy.. Stop crying, it’s over.” Mydei told him softly as he ran his fingers against Phainon’s skin tenderly - doing his best to listen to the soft whimpers of his mate who seemed to be cracking too much. 

“You’ll stay with me.. Won’t you?” Phainon shakily asked, voice quiet and hushed but that only made Mydei softly chuckle, still rolling his thumb against the alpha’s hot and wet face now as he knew fully well that man wanted to be comforted.

And what kind of omega would Mydei be if he did not sweeten his scent just a little and lean into that man, speaking just as lowly; “I braided my hair today, didn’t I?” 

Icy blue eyes leisurely moved to meet Mydei’s own - staring at him for a long moment all before the alpha broke into a sorry little laugh. A breathy thing, one that sounded more stressed than happy towards the situation right now, and Mydei thought that was fitting, considering the whole ‘corpses behind Phainon’ thing. 

“So you did..” Phainon murmured as his eyes flicked rather obviously to that braid at the side of Mydei’s head, all before darting right back up to meet Mydei’s eyes,  “Mydei..” 

“I will have to collar you and chain you down if you keep doing this, however.” Mydei sighed as that alpha leaned into him - enough to put his own head onto Mydei’s shoulder and the omega only huffed over that. Ignoring the way his shoulder felt a bit wet from Phainon’s pathetic little show of crying. 

“You know, I am rather fond of that idea when you’re the one saying it.” Phainon mumbled quietly as he nosed his way to the crook of Mydei’s neck - softly rubbing into Mydei to where he could only blink and raise a hand to the back of Phainon’s head. Leisurely patting him in comfort painfully slowly - eyes trying not to focus on the deceased now that Phainon was moving to give him a.. Better view of it.

Not due to the fact he was weak to seeing corpses, but due to the fact he was weak to knowing Phainon of all people had done this yet again. His sunshine that brightened his entire world so easily had fallen so far.

It hurt more than just a little. 

“Keep leaving me at night and I’ll have to. How many others have you killed?” Mydei inquired as he moved a hand through Phainon’s hair - feeling how soft it was, a horrible contrast to the actions Phainon had done today, that much was certain. 

“Does it matter? The less you know, the better.” 

Mydei had to grit his teeth over that - mainly due to the fact that surely meant too many. So many that Phainon didn’t want to tell Mydei at all.

“.. I see. Maybe I need to keep you leashed all the time.”  Mydei mumbled, feeling as if he did need to start doing such a thing if Phainon kept doing things like this.

There were other methods to be used, and considering the difference in their backgrounds.. Mydei didn’t quite understand how they had swapped so brutally. 

“I can behave.” Phainon mumbled into Mydei’s neck - making him bite back a shiver as he thought about those words.

Behave.

He had done nothing of the sort lately, and Mydei could only press out a sigh over that; “Can you?” 

“Mm.” 

Well.

That reply was less than satisfactory, that much was obvious as Mydei closed his eyes and ceased combing his fingers through the alpha’s hair. 

“What was even the reason for this, Phainon?” Mydei asked in a horribly hushed tone, unsure of what answer he could even really receive from an alpha who continuously seemed to believe that murder was a valid option to solve politics.

“Precautionary measures.” 

Those words were said so simply that Mydei found himself almost reeling over it - mind blanking as he tried to understand what was fully happening here. 

“.. Against your own council members?” Mydei asked, moving away slightly just to take that alpha’s free hand into his own - leading him away leisurely.

If Phainon was to be some sort of monster deep beneath the surface, that was fine. Mydei was fine trying to hide that from people, so long as at the end of the day they were together - it was fine. 

Phainon followed after him easily, not needing to be asked - so eager and happy to come along either way, “Some people are in disagreement with our wedding, that’s all.” 

“So, you’re..” Mydei trailed off, doing his best to understand how Phainon’s brain worked.

But it was incredibly simple to figure out, wasn’t it? He just wanted to keep Mydei safe, and all to himself..

.. So Mydei really did need to figure out a way to make Phainon calm down and come back to the reality of not needing to murder so many people.

“Can I pick out my own chain? Can they go on my wrists as well?” Phainon asked, and that was such a ridiculous thought that Mydei had to scoff over it.

Mainly because at this point, chaining Phainon down at night or to himself may actually be the best option. At least, until Phainon got ahold of himself once again. 

 “.. Ridiculous. Aglaea will have your hands cut off for this.” Mydei huffed, rolling his eyes even though his own hand tightened on the alpha’s still trembling one - and Mydei’s mind didn’t dare to linger on the question of it being from the thrill of taking people’s lives, or the dread of what he had done.

For some reason, he could only assume it was the first thought, and that only made his own skin crawl with the thought crossing his mind. 

“I did not think of that earlier.” Phainon confessed on the other hand - laughing much too honey sweet for Mydei’s ears currently, much too intoxicating and comforting for a man who had wet bloody hands wrapped around Mydei’s own.

And yet, Mydei found himself only scoffing and giving a small smile to his partner who was happily beaming at his side innocently. 

“Do not whimper for me to help you with her and Cyrene.”

“Mydei..”
